He removed his materials from the room so that his co-travellers might help him in putting them on his donkey. He was doing everything fast and went into the stable and found that his donkey was missing. He thought that the servant might have taken it out to give water, as it had drunk little water on the previous night. When the servant arrived, he asked him as to where his donkey was. The servant said: “You are an elderly bearded man, have regard for your beard”, and argument ensued between them. The sufi said: “I had handed over my donkey to you and made you its caretaker. Tell me an acceptable answer; do not argue unnecessarily. Give back to me what I had given to you. I want to take from you what I had given to you. Return it to me. The Prophet has said: ‘Whatever has been received by you, must ultimately be returned’. If you do not come to terms and agree to meet my demand, you may see that, you are one, I am one, and the court of the law of Qazi is there”.

The servant said: “I was overtaken by the Sifis and they all pounced upon me and I was afraid of my life. You throw your liver, lungs and heart before the cats and then try to find them back. I was like a single bread among a hundred hungry fellows. My lonely, weak cat had to face a hundred dogs”.

The sufi said: “I agree that they coercively took away the donkey from you and they were all after the blood of a poor man like me. But you did not come to me and tell me: ‘O poor man, they are taking away your donkey, so that I could take back my donkey from the one who had taken it away or they all would have collected donations and given its price to me. When they were one hundred they could have made this arrangement and contributed to meet the price. Now, everyone of them has left for his country. Whom should I catch now and whom should I take before the Qazi. All this trouble has fallen upon me because of you”.

The servant said: “By God! I came to you many times to inform you of their acts. But you were telling: ‘My son, the donkey went away’. And you were also telling this more enthusiastically than others. I returned thinking that you were aware of it. You were in consonance with this fate, you being a well informed ‘aarif”.

The sufi said: “They were all singing this with all enthusiasm. Their song created an enthusiasm in me too. My blind followership of those fellows has spoiled me. May hundred curses be upon such blind followership. In particular of those worthless who have disgraced themselves for eating and losing their honour. The reflection of the enthusiasm of that group was falling upon my heart, and my heart was also becoming enthusiastic with their reflection”.

sections.heading: Reflections of Perfect Guide:
paras: Reflection from good friends is required so much that you may be fully covered by it like the sea that shows no reflection; that is: the essense of God. Consider the first reflection that falls ( like scratches) upon you from a perfect guide as blind followership. And when it goes on falling again and again, its result ceases to be blind followership and becomes research and new finding. Do not go away from him until you become a researcher. Until the drop of water becomes a pearl, it should not get separated from the oyster. If you want to have clear wisdom, your eyes and ears should tear up the curtains of greed, as because of greed, the sufi followed blindly and was deprived of the light of wisdom. He was misled by greed to fall into a pit, into loss and got his jobs spoiled. Greed of delicious food and of music and his taste for them prevented his wisdom from correct information. If greed happens to fall on the mirror, it will also become a hypocrite like us and show the things in a distorted fashion. So also, if a balance becomes greedy of goods, it will not give correct measurements. The balance says: “I agree that you will become rich like Qaaruun by manipulating with me out of your greed, but your ultimate end is in the graveyard”.

Every prophet told his community with all sincerity: “I do not expect any reward from you for my message-giving. I am just a middleman and God is your purchaser. God has given me my commission receivable from both sides, as is the practice with middlemen. Every middleman expects his commission and he has to be paid that to render honest service”. The Prophet also said: “My reward is the sighting of the Friend, even when Abu Bakr places forty thousand dinars in my hand. His forty thousand dinars cannot be the reward for my labour”. What value can a beed have against a pearl from Aden?

sections.heading: Greed for Stories:
paras: I shall tell a story to you. Listen carefully so that you may understand that greed is a block for the ear. A greedy man becomes dumb. With greed in it, a heart never becomes bright. Thoughts of wealth and elevated status are like the hair fallen into the eyes, except in the case of a man who is intoxicated with the thoughts of truth. Even if you offer a treasure to him, he will not put even a passing glance. One who is engaged in godly thoughts considers the worldly things as dead bodies as stated by the Prophet: ‘this word is like a dead body and those crazy for it are like dogs’.

But that sufi was away from this kind of intoxication and consequently he was deprived of the light because of his greed for food and music. With greed, a person hears a hundred stories about greed, but not a single point enters into his ears because of his engagement in greed. He is greedy for stories only not of wise points.

There was a poor man with no possession of house and materials, who was imprisoned in the jail. He used to eat up the food meant for other prisoners. Because of his greed he was heavy upon the hearts of the people like the Qaaf(Caucasus) mountain. Nobody had the strength to take his food as he used to snatch it from his hand. One who is away from the mercy of God is a beggar, even if he is a king. His eyes are like beggar’s. That fellow had crushed his shame of shame under his feet. The whole prison had become a hell because of his bread-snatching. If you run toward comforts, troubles will come to you from that side also. No corner of the world remains without beasts and birds attempting to snatch your food, excepting the one in seclusion with God.

This world is an inevitable corner of the prison-house from which none has an escape. Everywhere one has to struggle and run about. The mat upon which one sits to do one’s hard work gets damaged sooner. Even if you take refuge in a rat’s pit, you cannot escape from the paws of the cat. These are all the troubles that are around and outside of man.

A man’s fatness is by his thoughts, if they are beautiful. And if they are regretful thoughts, he will melt down like wax on fire. With good godly thoughts, God will keep him happy even when surrounded by snakes and scorpions. Snakes and scorpions will become your friends with your good thoughts and they also become a chemical to convert copper into gold. Patience upon troubles becomes sweet with good thoughts, as they also provide solace and comforts. Pleasures in the heart come from faith; and lack of faith causes despair and sorrows. Patience provides a crown to the head, and where there is no faith, there is no patience. The Prophet has said: ‘God has not given faith to anyone who does not possess patience’.

sections.heading: One Person Appears to You as a Serpent but Becomes a Means of Beautification in the View of Another. This Is Because of Your, Having a Thought of Him of Being an Infidel, but His Friends See Him as a Faithful. Everyone Has Both Good and Bad Things in Him. Sometimes He Is Like a Fish and Sometimes Like the Fish-Hook. Half of Him Is Faithful and the Other Half Is Infidel. Half of His Is Greed and the Other Half Is Patience. God Has Said: It Is He Who Has Created You; and of You Some That Are Unbelievers and Some Are Believers: “Huwallazi Kalaqakum Faminkum Kafirun Wa Minkum Mu’minun”: (Al Taghaabun: 64: 2). This Is Like a Cow, Half the Skin of Which Is Black and the Other Half White Like the Moon. Whoever Looks at This Half Rejects It and Another Who Looks at the Other Half, Tries to Buy It
paras: With the beauty of H.Yusuf, his brothers were hateful of him, but it was like a light in the eyes of his father, H.Yaqub. His brothers considered him ugly because of their evil thoughts. They had apparent eyes which were only instruments to see, but did not have the real, hidden eyes of the heart through which to see the reality. Consider the physical eyes as the images of the inner eyes; they turn that side towards which the real eyes turn. The shadow of the real eye cannot stand before the real eye, just as shadow cannot face the sun. You are now in the world of space with a physical body, but your reality belongs to the world beyond space (Laa Makaan). Therefore, close this shop of yours in this world and open the other shop. Do not run toward all the six directions of left-right-front-back, and up-down as they entangle you, and you cannot escape from them; and one getting entangled meets a defeat in the end like the chesspiece surrounded from all sides. There is no end to this discussion. The inmates of the prison were worried because of this shameless glutton.

The inmates of the prison started complaining before the Qazi’s prosecutor: “Please convey our salutations to the Qazi, and narrate to him the troubles we are getting at the hands of this mean fellow.He is lodged in this prison ever since. He is vagabond, gluttonous and troublesome. In the prison, the prisoners do not get their bread properly and get it with many efforts. Instantly that fellow with his throat like hell, comes forward depending upon the command of God: “Eat (kuluu)”, tearing it out of context. Just as the housefly arrives every time while others are eating, he arrives without invitation and salutation. Food of sixty persons is nothing for him. If he is told to stop eating more, he makes himself deaf as though he has not heard at all. This gluttonous fellow has been a cause of famine in the prison from the past three years. This is our complaint before your lordship, May your shadow be upon us for ever. Please issue an order for that male buffalo to be kept away from the prison, or some other alternate arrangements be made for his food from the wakf. O the one with whom all men and women are in contentment, do justice to us. We seek your help.”

The prosecutor faithfully went to the Qazi and placed before him everything, point by point. The Qazi called that troublesome fellow from the prison before him and made enquiries with the concerned people. All that was told to him by the co-prisoners proved to be true.
The Qazi told him: “Get up and go away from the prison to your ancestral home”.

The prisoner said: “My house and livelihood are your grace, and what is your prison is like a paradise for me, as the Prophet has said: This world is a prison for the faithful, and paradise for the unbeliever. Even if you chase me out of the prison by force, I shall meet my death due to poverty and hard work.”

sections.heading: Like Iblis Who Said: “O My God, Give Me Respite Till the Day They Are Raised Up: “Anziirni Ilaa Yawmi Yub’ath(s)uuna”: (A’raf: 7: 14). I Am Quite Happy in This Prison of the World so That I May Kill the Children of My Enemy. Whoever Is Provided with the Food of Faith and Carries It with Him on His Journey to the Next World Would Be Deprived of It by Me with Treachery or with Misguidance, so That He May Be in Cries and Pains. Sometimes I Shall Frighten Him with Poverty and Deprivation; and Sometimes by Involving Him in the Observation of Beautiful Eyes, Tufts and Moles of Beautiful Women”
paras: There is very little food of faith in this prison of the world, and what little is there, is being snatched away by gluttonous, greedy dogs. Whatever taste of this food of faith develops by daily prayers, fasting and hundred types of other good deeds is snatched away by Satan. I seek refuge from God from his devil. How sorrowful, we are all put to loss because of his dominant mischiefs.

sections.heading: Devil in the Form of Thoughts:

One Devil Like the Dog, Penetrates into a Group of Thousands of Men and Makes Them All Like Himself. and Whoever Goes with Him Becomes One Like Him. Consider Whatever That Cools and Slackens You in the Worship of God as from Him. It Is Not Necessary for the Devil to Come Before You in Human Form. He Is Well Hidden Within Yourself Under Your Skin. If It Does Not Come in a Physical Form, He Will Certainly Come in Your Imagination so That the Imagination Causes Great Troubles for You. Difficulties Come to You Because of Your Thoughts, as Your Thoughts Cause Mischief for You Everywhere. Sometimes, the Thoughts of Your Well-Established Positions, Sometimes of Your Shop and Establishment, Sometimes of Your Great Learning,sometimes of Your Home and Properties, Sometimes of Your Profession and Business, and Sometimes of Your Elevated Status and Official Power. Sometimes the Thoughts of Gold, Children and Wife; and Sometimes of Your Oratory Skills and Sometimes of Oncoming Sorrows
paras: Sometimes the thoughts of your gardens, farms and factories, and sometimes of clouds and mist, and sometimes of your weaknesses and joys. Sometimes the thoughts of war and sometimes of peace and sometimes of honours and disgraces. Sometimes of your positions and decorations, sometimes of floors and carpets.

Be careful to eliminate all these thoughts from your mind and eliminate all vicious designs from your heart. Be careful always to say “La Hawla” to ward off the devil not only from your tongue but also from your heart.

The Qazi told him to prove his destitution. He said: “The prisoners are the witnesses before you”. Qazi said: Their evidence is not reliable, as they are interested witnesses, because they are disgusted with you, shedding tears of blood because of you. They want to get rid of you and therefore, they would make false allegations against you.”

sections.heading: Treatment of Insolvents:
paras: All the officials of the court said: “We are all witnesses to his being a destitute and accursed fellow”. With whomsoever the Qazi enquired about him said: “Sir, you may get rid of him”. The Qazi said: “Take him in all the streets and beat loud drums to announce his indigency, so that nobody may give anything to him on credit. Let not anybody lend him even half-a-farthing. It is the Law that a non-payer of debts is to be put into prison. But he cannot be imprisoned, if he is indigent. Anybody making a claim against him will not be entertained as he is a declared insolvent and pauper. I shall not imprison him on this account. His destitution is established before me. He does not possess any cash and materials with him”.

Man is kept in the prison of this world so that his destitution may be established. Our God has called the devil as destitute and made a declaration of this in the Qur’ān, so that nobody may have any dealing with him as he is treacherous, destitute and ill- tempered. Nobody should enter into trade and partnership with him.If you have any dealings with him, he will plead many untenable arguments. He is indigent and nothing can be recovered from him upon the decree of the court.

When the court order was put into execution, people brought a camel of a Kurd who was selling firewood. The hapless Kurd pleaded very much to release the camel. He also gave some money to the footmen; but his camel was not released. The camel was taken away in the morning, but his cries were of no use for him. The glutton sat upon the camel and the camel-man ran behind. He was taken in all directions, and from street to street, and the entire city became familiar with him. In every bazaar and in every public bathroom people became familiar with his face.

Ten announcers were shouting loudly in Turkic, Kurdish, Roman and Arabic saying: “This man has sown the seeds of cruelty. He is indigent and he has nothing with him. No one may lend a farthing to him. Neither in the open nor in hiding. This fellow does not possess anything. He is an indigent, tricky and treacherous heap of mud; poor, immoral and dishonest. He snatches bread, always begging and shameless.Be careful not to have any dealing with him, as he has scissors to cut your pocket. Keep your money well secured. If you bring this dead man to court to recover your debts, I'm not the one to put a dead man in prison. He is very talkative and has a very wide throat. He wears clothes that appear to be new but his undergarments are torne into pieces. If ever he happens to be in new clothes, they would be those borrowed from someone and not his own to deceive you”.

Words of wisdom on the tongue of the unwise may be considered as borrowed clothes. A thief may be in good clothing giving the appearance of a nobleman, yet he cannot shake hands with you as he has got his hand severed.

When that poor fellow got down from the camel, the Kurd, owner of the camel told him: “My house is far away, and it is late in the night. You have been seated on my camel from the morning. I shall ignore my demand for millet but give something to buy grass”. He said: “What have we been telling, all through you fool! Where are your senses. O greedy fellow, the announcement of my poverty has been heard by the sky. Did you not hear with your sharp ears? The drum beating of my poverty has reached upto the seventh heaven and you did not hear of this matter. Your ears are full of sounds of greed. Know this my boy: greed makes the ears deaf. Even the bricks and stones have heard this announcement, as to what kind of shameless destitute this man is. The announcers shouted from morning till the night, but they had no effect on this camel-man as his ears are full of greed”.

sections.heading: God Provides Medicine to Sickness:
paras: Ears and eyes have been sealed by God. Many faces and sounds are only behind the curtains. Whomsoever He wishes is provided with the sight to see the beauty, perfectness and wonders. Whomsoever, He wishes He sends the sounds up to the ears, be of qawwalis, good news and noises. Though you may be careless about all these now, at the appropriate time of need, God will expose them to you. The Prophet has said: ‘Glorious God has created the medicine for all kinds of sicknesses. You may search for the treatment and say with your heart, praying: O God, provide the relief of the trouble, and it may come about. Yet you cannot see the colour and feel the smell of the treatment, provided to you without His command”.

O searcher of relief, keep your eyes engaged looking in the ‘La Makaan’ (the world beyond space), just as a murdered man’s eyes remain open and wide, as though searching for the lost soul. The world is full of medicines, but there is no medicine for you until God opens a hole for it to pass through. This world is created by the One who has no spacial dimensions. It is a creation that has come from a place which has no materials to make. It is from out of no place (La makaan) that it has come about. So also, you have come about from nullity. Therefore, go back to nullity, if you really desire for the Master, with your life and soul. This world of nullity (‘adam) is a place of earnings, where you get everything. Do not avoid and run away from it. This material existence is a place of increase and decrease and expansion. As the factory of the True Maker is nullity, this world of products is nothing but worthlessness.

O God, the Absolute without partner and supporter, support us and forgive us for our sins. Teach us those subtle words, which are the cause of your mercy for us. Our prayer is from You and its acceptance is also by You; our contentment is from You and our fear is also from You. If we say something wrong, do set them right. You are the king of all statements; do correct them. You have chemicals that can change the nature of elements. You can convert a stream of blood into a large river Nile. Making such decorations is Your work and alterations of chemicals are Your secrets.

You mixed up mud and water and made the form of H.Adam. Then you created a relationship of husband and wife, maternal and paternal uncles, with thousands of joys and sorrows. Then You got some of them rid of their joys and sorrows. Then You totally removed these feelings from the hearts of Your friends and made every enjoyable thing unworthy in their views. Such a person rejects all sensory things and makes the incensory (spiritual) things as his supporters. His love is apparent, but his beloved is hidden. He has no concern for this or that world, which are causes of trial. That is to say: he is involved in the true love of God.

sections.heading: Love Needs No Form and Shape:
paras: Follow him and ignore the formal shapes and love for them. For example, your love is not for the form and face of your wife, as you have the love for her, even when she is no more. A beloved is loved not for the form and beauty, as love has nothing to do with form and face. You continue to have your love for her even when she has gone away from you; and in her absence. This shows that love is not for the form. And you should thus try to understand as to what is it that you love.

Animals also have faces and forms. But they have no love for each other. That is to say: forms and faces have nothing to do with love. When the beloved reciprocates your love, your love increases for the beloved, even though it is the same face and form that was in the initial stage of love. Here it is not the face and form that enhances the love, but something else: that is reciprocation from the other side. Reciprocation does not bring about any change in the form and face.

The light of the sun falls on the wall and brightens it, but this is as long as the sunlight falls on it but, sun, the source of light continues to be bright, because that is the cause of light. One should think of the original cause of light. The sun is like the wall in relationship with the light of God. Therefore, one should consider the light of all bright matters as caused by the original light. Simpletons go after the receivers and reflectors of light like lumps of mud. You should search for the real original light.

sections.heading: Love of Forms: It Is a Way to Real Love
paras: Yet there are those, who due to lack of proper understanding think that they also love the original light (God) and consider themselves as better than those who love forms and faces. They consider the love of form as the worldly love (Ishq-e-majaazi) of creatures, as a means to go forward to the real love of God (Ishq-e-haqiiqi). This is a curtain of confusion put on their minds. Copper cannot become gold just because they think it to be so. These are only the intellectual aberrations of their minds. Man’s beauty is temporary like the light on the wall, as otherwise, why does a human beloved become ugly like an old donkey. One who was beautiful like the angel becomes frightening like the ghost, because one’s beauty was only temporarily bestowed. God takes away that beauty in a little by little slow manner. In this slow manner a green fresh tree slowly dries up. Read in the Qur’an: “Wa man mu’ammirhu nunakkishu fil khalq”: We grant long life to any: we cause him to be reversed in nature: (Surah Yasin: 36: 68). Search for the heart and do not go after bones, because the beauty of the heart is lasting. Its lips are the providers of the life-giving-water to a man who gets himself lost in God. He becomes water, the provider of water and the drinker of water and the three rolled into one. There is no trinity. You cannot understand this through your wisdom. Engage yourself in prayers and meditation to know this. Do not blabber empty words from your mouth as ignorant proud fellows do, as they are like the bitter grass which even the camel refuses to eat.

Your base is also a temporary form. You are happy at your proportionate, symmetrical parts. You are in love with them by mistaking them as real. But your reality is that which is not in this form. It is that which takes you away from the form and appearance. Reality is not that which makes you blind and deaf and more loving towards form. Blindness increases one’s sorrows as these physical eyes are the source of these mortal thoughts.

sections.heading: Qur’ān Is Not Words, but Meanings:
paras: Similarly, words of the Qur'an are forms. The blind men at heart look only at the words and take the Qur'an as a mine of words. They do not look at the meanings. They are like that blind fellow who sits at the saddle and not at the donkey. If you have eyes go after the donkey not after the saddle, as when you have the donkey, it is easy to get the saddle. So long as your soul is in the body, your food will certainly come to you. There will be no deficiency of saddles for one who has a donkey. The saddle will come to the donkey on its own, as the back of the donkey is the place of making earnings and wealth. So also, your life is the capital for making a hundred forms of many things. Therefore, do not be blind and search for the saddle, and sit alone on the back of the donkey even without the saddle; as it is riding and moving that is important, for which donkey is needed and not the saddle. Do you not know that the Prophet had sat up on the back of a donkey without the saddle? It is reported: the Prophet rode on an unsaddled donkey; and also that he journeyed on foot. The basic object is to go on a journey weather on the back of the donkey or by walk.

sections.heading: Only Work Gives, Not Hopes:
paras: Your mischievous, vicious self has gone out of your control. Catch it and tie it to the peg. This ought to be your job and do not avoid it for long. Man has to do his job sometime or the other, be it a hundred, thirty or twenty years. No lifter of burden can lift the burden of another. Nobody reaped the harvest without first sowing. Expecting something without work is baseless greed. Eating raw food brings about sickness. You cannot say: “Someone found a treasure all of a sudden; I also desire to hope for it. There is no need for me to work”. What is gotten by him is merely by luck and this is very rare. One should work to earn a livelihood so long as one has strength in the body. Your struggle to earn does not come in the way of you getting a treasure by luck. Be sure, your job is dependent upon you and after you. Do not get entangled in ‘ifs’ and ‘buts’ saying: “If I were to do this or do that”.

The Prophet has prevented us from saying ‘if ’: saying ‘if ’ is hypocrisy, as a hypocrite dies while being in the stage of ‘if ’; and one gets into losses only while being caught in ‘ifs’ and ‘buts’. Many people died while being in the state of ‘perhaps’ and ‘but’, without tasting the fruit of the tree of efforts. If you have not understood the loss that is caused by ‘if’ and ‘but’, hear this story, so that you may understand.

A poor man was searching for a house. A friend took him to a dilapidated house and said: “If this house had a roof, it would have been a good house in my neighbourhood. Your family members would also be in comfort, if it had another room in between. And any guest coming to your house would also be comfortable, if you were in this house. How good it would have been if this house were occupied by you, in which case, this well occupied house of ours would also have been yours.”

His friend said: “Certainly the neighbourhood of friends is very good; but my friend, there cannot be a residence, if it is connected with ‘if’. This entire world desires for good things, but because of the imagined goodness people are in fire. Every old and young man is desirous of gold, but ordinary eyes cannot differentiate between pure and impure. Good polish on counterfeit gold has brightened it and therefore, without proper touchstone and merely on speculation do not buy it. If you have the ability to test it, you may buy it or go to some experienced person to test and advise you. Better it is that you possess your own ability to test, and if you do not possess it, do not go alone. There are many ghosts on the way who call the travellers to come to them saying: this is the right way and the direction towards the destination. They call everyone by name so as to put all of them among those already destroyed by them. When someone reaches that place, he sees only wolf and lion, thus resulting in loss of time, falling away from the destination, and the days lost forever”.

sections.heading: Ghostly Call: Desire for Wealth, Honour and Status:
paras: Know gentleman, as to what is the calling of the ghost. It is a desire for materials, high status and honour in the society. These callings come to you from your inside. Stop them, so that you may know the secrets of life. Take the name of God and set fire to the callings of the ghost. Ignore the vulture of the ghost with the eyes of narcissus, as narcissus is like an eye only in beauty and shape without light. That is to say, look and overlook the ghost with the name of God. Understand the difference between false dawn and true dawn and that between the colour of the wine and of the glass. With this there is a possibility that the physical eye with its seven membranes and capacity to see seven colours, creating another eye with patience and determination to overcome these callings. So also you may see others apart from the seven colours. There is also a possibility that with your patience and determination, you may develop the capacity to see unity of color in differences and also see other colours invisible to others. And also see pearls as against pebbles. What are just pearls? You can even become a sea containing pearls. Not just that, you can also become the sun that crosses over the sky.

sections.heading: Enter the God’s Workshop:
paras: God, the artisan of the universe, is sitting in His workshop and get inside to see Him. God’s creations have put a curtain before Him and prevent you from seeing Him. Yet, He is visible through His markings. You cannot see Him other than through His creations. He can only be seen within His workshop. The Artisan has His settled place, but those outside the workshop do not see Him. You can see Him only if you enter into the world of non-material existence by making your physical existence non-existent, when you can see the Artisan and His artisanship together. The workshop is the place to see everything clearly and there is no scope for seeing clearly from outside the workshop, and seeing Him is possible only when you stop seeing yourself.

Pharaoh was looking at himself without looking beyond and inevitably, he was blind to the workshop of God. He definitely tried to alter his fate so as to chase the determination of God from the threshold of his house. But the determination of God was smiling underneath its moustaches continuously. Pharaoh killed thousands of innocent children to counter and chase away God’s determination, so that Prophet Musa may not come into existence. He carried the burden of the sin of thousands of murders on his neck. He made so many killings and yet H.Musa did come into existence, and was ready to smash his head. Had Pharaoh seen the workshop of the Eternal God, his hands and feet would have dried up and the children saved. And H.Musa was comfortably living in his very house when he was killing children outside.

In similar way, a man’s vicious self is strengthening his body and engaging him in enmity to those outside him, considering this man to be enemy, that man as jealous of him, and another against him, even though he is jealous and enemy of himself. He is like Hazrat Musa and his body is like Pharaoh going in search of his enemy here and there. Your ‘self’ is living within the house of your body with all comforts, and you are feeling ill of others.

A man out of anger killed his mother, both with blows of hands and with knife. Another man told him: “Out of your bad nature, you have killed your mother. How miserable! You ugly fellow! Why did you kill her? Why are you keeping quiet? Why don’t you tell? What has she done to you? You horribly mischievous fellow! Has anybody ever killed his mother? Why don’t you open your mouth? What did she do and what was the matter?”

That fellow said: “She did an act which was a matter of disgrace for her. I killed her because mud only could put a curtain on her act. She had an affair with someone, and therefore, I killed her. I gave her a bath of blood and mixed her up with the mud of the grave.”
That other man said: “O good man, you should have killed the person involved.”
He said: “Should I kill one person every day? I killed her and saved myself from the killing of many persons. It was better that her throat was cut off than that of many persons.”

sections.heading: Your Vicious Self: Mother of All Wrongs:
paras: Your vicious self is your vicious mother of all vices. All vices come out of it on all sides. Therefore, be warned to kill it for its meanness as it is because of it only that you think of killing a dear one. It is because of it only that this vast beautiful world becomes narrow for you. It is because of it only that you wage a war against God and the people. If you kill your self, you get rid of offering excuses or seeking pardons. Nobody will be your enemy in the world.

If someone raises an objection on this point, by taking the example of prophets and saints that though they had killed their ‘self’, yet they had enemies and the jealous. By killing our ‘self’, we cannot get rid of enemies. Then, my dear seeker of the correct answer, hear my clarifications on this doubt and objection.

sections.heading: Men as Enemies of Themselves:
paras: The rejecters of the prophets were enemies of their own selves. They were inflicting injuries upon themselves. Enemy is one who is after someone’s life. One cannot be an enemy of another who takes away one’s own life. A bat is not an enemy of the sun, but in reality, is its own enemy. Sun’s brightness is capable of killing it. It does not feel any of the pains that the bat feels. Enemy is one who causes pain and loss which the bat feels. The same brightness is received by the ruby without any pain but with gain. All unbelievers of the prophets caused obstacles for themselves from the rays falling from the gems of the prophets. The curtains tied by them did not cause any obstacles for those unique personalities of their times but did so for themselves. People have made themselves blind and deaf. They have contempt for them like the Indian slave, who out of his ill manners and enmity for his master killed himself. He felled himself from the roof of the house to cause financial loss to the master without caring for the loss of his own life.

sections.heading: Self Deprivation by Hate:
paras: A sick man hating a physician, and a child hating a teacher, cause loss to themselves. They cut off the paths of their lives and wisdom, and become enemies of their own selves. If a washerman gets angry with the sun or the fish becomes inimical to water, just imagine to whom they are causing loss. If God has created you with an ugly face, you may not add bad conduct and character to it and increase its ugliness. Do not walk on a stony path, if you do not have the shoes to wear; and do not add two more branches of troubles to the already existing two and make them four.

sections.heading: Adding to Troubles by Jealousy:
paras: You feel jealous of someone because he has more than what you have and he is increasing your deficiency. He is not doing that, but you only feel as such. To your loss and deficiency, you add more through your jealousy. Rather it is a vice worse than all other vices. Iblis, out of his feeling of deficiency and lack of honour got himself involved in hundreds of difficulties. Out of jealousy he desired that he should become superior. But instead of going higher, he fell into a bloody pit. That Abu Jahl felt ashamed of himself by his comparison with H.Muhammad; and out of jealousy desired to go above him, but instead of going up he got the title, Abu Jahl (Father of Ignorance) for himself when his real name was Abul Hakam(Father of wisdom). Many people became worthless due to jealousy.

sections.heading: Jealousy Comes Between Equals:
paras: I have not seen in this world of ups and downs, anything better than good conduct. Prophets have been made as a yardstick in order to expose jealousy in a clean manner. Go away from the feelings of your excellence, superiority and expertise. These are not proud possessions; but service to others and good conduct are. If God had not made the prophets as go between Himself and the people, jealousy would not have been exposed. Nobody considers comparing himself with God. Nobody has any jealousy for Him. A man becomes jealous of only that person whom he considers as his equal or who has gone ahead of him. When the superiority of the Prophet was settled, no faithful person felt any jealousy for him in accepting this.

sections.heading: Saints Replace Prophets:
paras: To meet the same purpose, in every period of time there is a saintly person, as the practise of jealousy has not come to end. This will go till the doomsday. Good people get deliverance through him; the hard-hearted meet their doom. He will be a living and well-settled saint, irrespective of whether he comes from among the descendents of H.Umar or H.Ali. He is the guide(Hadi) and the one upon whom guidance is settled, that is, one guided by God(Mahdi). That is, he is both a Hadi and a Mahdi. He is like the light of God, and his wisdom is like his Jibra’iil. Other saints receive light from him like qindil (bulb) who are of a lower level than the earlier mentioned one. Still those of the lower level are like the niches in our homes. These are the grades of saints enlightened by God. These levels are for the reason that God is hidden behind seven hundred curtains. These grades of the saints may be considered as curtains of light. Behind every curtain is a place of a community. These curtains are in ranks after ranks until they reach the chief saint.

sections.heading: Grades of Saints:
paras: Those in the last rank are not capable of the seeing the great light of God because of their general weakness and incompetence. Those in the last but one rank do not have the capacity to see the great light because of the weakness of their eyes. Thus, they are in graded capacity with improved state from the last rank forward. The greatest light is seen by those in the first rank and this light for them is their life and everything. This great light becomes troublesome and a cause of trial for those in the last rank. From the last rank, when one proceeds upward, one’s weakness gradually gets reduced (and gains strength) and when one thus passes from all the seven hundred curtains, one comes to the level of directly facing God’s light. One becomes “one who is He”, that is, one becomes “one with God”.

sections.heading: Heat and Light: Relative:
paras: The fire that cleans gold or silver of impurities cannot become one to clean fruits like apples. Fruits contain a little unripeness requiring little warmth to ripen. They are not strong and hard like iron. They require only a little heat. But that much heat has no impact on iron because it has the strength to swallow the pythons of heat. The saint is such a strong iron that enjoys that strong heat that reddens it and also makes it capable of receiving the blows of the hammers. The usefulness and benefit of things are dependent upon the bearing capacities of the things and persons. The well-settled saint becomes the protector of heat for other objects and directly penetrates into the burning flames. He is bright and happy with the hammer-beatings and fire like iron.

sections.heading: Obstacles Needed for Some, Not for Saints:
paras: Things containing water do not get cooked directly in fire. They (like bread) need an obstacle between themselves and fire to be cooked. That obstacle may be of pot or frying pan. They are as much needed as footwear is needed for walking. Or they need air heated by fire around them, as in ovens. Similarly trees grow with hot air around them. The saints do not need such go-betweens. They directly receive the heat of the burning fire. They have a direct relationship with fire.

The saint is as important for the world as the heart is for the body, both physical-biological heart, as well as the spiritual human soul. It is through the physical heart that man survives and through the spiritual heart that he progresses. If there is no physical heart, body cannot speak and if the spiritual heart does not search, the body cannot go in search.

Words have to come out of the mouth with the control of the air from the lungs passing through the mouth during which course of air, different muscles of the mouth, throat, tongue, cheeks, lips are controlled by the physical heart through the brain to produce sounds of words. And the spiritual human heart (human soul) produces the ideas and expressions that have to come out of the body of man. The coordination of the human spiritual heart and the physical-biological heart is the cause of all progress of spoken intellectual work. And also of one person’s heart with another person’s heart in the world, which brought about progress of humanity from the level of ape to the civilized level of our days. This progress in a slow and systematic manner can also be taken as journey from the last seven hundredth rank to the last but one rank, and step by step to the first rank, in respect of material advancement in time and space, similar to what is indicated by Rumi in respect of attainment of the spiritual light of God. (Translator)

In this manner the lover of the flames is iron and the lover of God is the heart and not the body. The hearts of all the saints of all the levels combined together are like the body and the one closest to God at the first rank level is like the mine of iron ore. This statement requires many examples to explain and elucidate; and if efforts are made to explain even a little, there is a fear that common men may fall into misguidance, in which case our good intentions and acts may become bad. What all that I have said so far is not by remaining in my senses but in a state of lack of self control. Things have to be told according to the standard of the hearers. Common man should not be told of subtle, intricate matters. A twisted shoe is needed for a twisted foot. The place of a beggar is at the threshold of the door to receive some alms. He will receive beatings if he gets inside.

A king purchased two slaves together at a cheap rate. He talked to one of them and heard from him. He found him to be very smart and sweet-tongued. After all, sweet lips drop sweet water. Man is hidden under the tongue. Tongue is a curtain of the court of life. When the blow of wind pulls the curtain, the secret of the courtyard of the house opens to us to show whether, there inside, are the grains of wheat or pearls. Treasures of gold are there or snakes and scorpions. Whether there is treasure of gold or the snake guarding the treasure on its borders, as the treasure of gold does not remain without a guard. The slave without any hesitation spoke of matters in such a way to speak of which others would think over five hundred times. He spoke as though there was an ocean within him with pearls or every word of what he spoke was a pearl. Every pearl shed a bright light in such a way that truth got separated from falsehood.

Light of the Qur'ān separates truth and falsehood for us particle by particle. Quran is also called as Furqan as it differentiates between truth and falsehood. Light of the gems becomes the light for our eyes in such a way that our question itself becomes the answer. Doubts arising in our minds get clarified. If you make yourself cross-eyed, the tablet of the moon appears as two, just as in the case of deliberate suspicions, objections are raised in the form of questions. If you look at the moon with straight eyes, you will see the moon as one. There lies the answer.

sections.heading: Tuition and Intuition:
paras: If you straighten your thinking and straighten your sight, everything will appear to be from the light of God. Every answer enters into the heart through the passage of the ear. But the light from inside(intuition) says: “hear from me and not from other sources”. Ear is only like a middle man to take them to the desired object to see, but the eye of intuition is the possessor of the state of reality of everything. Ear is only one among the talkers and intuition is the exhibitor. Hearing from ear only brings about changes in one's qualities, but direct witnessing through intuition changes the very essence of the observer.

sections.heading: Three Grades of Certainty:
paras: By merely hearing, one may consider a thing as bad and try to avoid it—such as fire burns. This is Ilmal Yaqiin. Yet by chance one experiences something which may lead to better results by giving some more perfect knowledge that, one who hears and personally observes that fire burns. This is sure knowledge— Ainal Yaqiin: observed knowledge. This is only theoretical knowledge that does not give certainty and assurance. But, if you really get a burning from fire, it gives a perfect assured knowledge that it burns and also causes pain and burning taking you to know assured knowledge and the very nature of the reality. This is the true knowledge; Haqqal yaqiin. If the ear is critical and analytic of what is heard, it becomes strong like intuition and believing (chashm-e-basiirat) of reality, otherwise, what is heard gets twisted in the channel of the ear. There is no end to this talk. Return to the king to know what the king did with his slaves.

When the king found the slave as wise and shrewd, he signalled to the other one to come nearer to him. He called him ‘slave child’ not by way of contempt but by way of affection just as a grandfather calls his grandson as ‘little babe’. When he came before the king, he was found to have a dirty mouth with black teeth. Though the king was unhappy with his foul-smelling-mouth, he wanted to know his secrets. He said to him: “With this face and foul-smelling-mouth, sit away from me. Do not come nearer. Do not bring yourself up nearer, as you are fit to be a carrier of messages and not of sitting with friends in gatherings. We have concern for you to treat the sickness of your mouth, as we are experts in that job. It is not proper to burn a new blanket just because a flea has entered into it. So, it is also not proper to shut our eyes from you. But you appear to be more capable than your friend and therefore, be nearer to us. With all these facts being there, say two-three narratives, so that we may better understand your wisdom”. The king sent the first fellow away on some job and telling him to go to the bathroom and wash himself. Then he said to the other slave to show as to “how smart he is, may be equal to a hundred ones. You are not like the one that your colleague spoke about you. That jealous fellow has made us turn against you. He has said that you are a thief, ill mannered and companion of bad fellows. You are cowardly, weak, this and that”.

The slave said: “ He (the other slave) is truthful always and always speaks of truth. I have not seen a more truthful person than him. He is straight-forward, good-natured and shy, dignified, religious, graceful and generous. Truthfulness is in his instinct itself. About, what he has said about me, I do not say that it is a false allegation. I do not find that well-intentioned man wrong. I accept myself as an accused. It is possible that he sees my defects. But O king, I cannot see my own inside. If anyone were to see his own defects in advance, he would not have remained without reforming himself. People are ignorant of themselves and it is for this reason that they speak of the ills of others. O worshipper of the face, I do not look at my own face, But I look at your face and your face appears to me as mine. One who sees one's own face finds it brighter than those of others. Even after his death, his brightness remains, as his seeing is like the seeing of God. That light is not physical light which sees itself, face to face with itself”. The king said, “You may also speak of his defects, one by one, just he has spoken of yours, so that I may know that you are my sympathiser and an administrator in the governance of the country”.

sections.heading: Sacrifices Do Not Go Unrewarded:
paras: The slave replied: “O king, I shall speak of his defects, even though he is a good friend of mine. His defects are love, honesty and humanness. His conduct is truthfulness, alertness and concern for others. His smallest of defects are generosity and gracefulness. Such a kind of generosity that he would even sacrifice life. God has created hundreds of thousands of living beings. How can one who has not seen all these lives, show any generosity. He who sees all these lives will sacrifice his own for the good of others to keep alive all the creatures of God, for the sake of God. By sacrificing his own life, he gets a life worth hundreds of thousands of lives. Nobody will be miserly to sacrifice his life if he comes to know of this kind of reward. He would not care for his own life for the good of the life of others. Only a blind fellow can think of storing water while living on the bank of a river, having not seen the flowing water of the river. The noble Prophet has said: “ One who is certain of the doomsday, will be certain of the reward for his life, that the reward of any good act is tenfold”. Such a person will be showing a new kind of generosity everytime.

sections.heading: Generosity Related to Eyes Not Hands:
paras: “Seeing a reward for every good act results in the elimination of the fear of poverty. Not looking at the rewards causes miserliness. Looking at the pearls makes the divers happy. If everyone were to be confident of the reward, no one in the world would be a miser as nobody gives anything to another without expecting a reward. Thus, it may be seen that generosity Is related to the eyes and not to the hands. Seeing of the reward with certainty (ainal yaqiin) is the only cause of generosity.”
The slave continued: “The other defect of that slave is that he does not look at his own achievements. He is a searcher and speaker of his own defects.He is good to all and bad to himself.”

The king said: “Do not be fast in the praise of a friend and do not try to praise yourself by praising others as men generally praise others to get praised. I shall take a test of him. I am afraid, in this matter you may be put to shame”.

The slave said: “No, I swear upon God, the great, Master of the countries, the Benevolent and Merciful! I am not telling lies. That great God who sent prophets not because he needed them but out of His grace and gratefulness. That Lord, Who with worthless mud created very great riders of spiritual horses. He cleansed them of the nature of mud and made them go ahead of the heavenly creatures. He rid them of fire and filled them with light, so that their light might outbeat all lights.

sections.heading: Chain of Prophets:
paras: That lightning flashed upon all the spirits, but so much upon Adam, that he alone got the light of the understanding of God. The light that H.Adam got went into H.Shaith(s), because of which H.Adam called him as his vicegerent. When H.Noah got the profit of that gem of light, he, through the waves of the ocean of his life, sprinkled pearls. Through the impacts of this grand light, H.Ibrahim without any hesitation, entered into the huge flames of fire. As H.Ismail entered into the stream of that light, he kept his throat under the sharp knife. H.Dawood’s life got so much heat from its light that iron became soft in his hands to be spun into thread. As H.Sulaiman drank the milk of this light, devils and fairies became his obedient slaves. Under the impact of this light H.Yaqoob, kept his head before God and he got his eyes brightened with the fragrance of his son. When the moon-like H.Yusuf looked at the Sun of this light, he became a great interpreter of dreams. When the dry staff of H.Musa drank water from his hand, it made the empire of Pharoah a morsel of its food.When the soul of H.Jarjis found out the secret of that light, he sacrificed his life and regained it for seven times, (Jarjis was the son of a follower of H.Isa, who was killed by his community).As H.Zakariah (Zacharias) took sighs in the love of this light, he went into the hollow of a tree for protection and his enemies sawed the tree to kill him. H.Yunus drank a gulp of the water of this light, he found rest in the belly of the fish. As H.Yahya (John) got intoxicated with the taste of this light, he got his head severed and placed on a golden plate (as a conspiracy with a women and of king, Mirdos, of his days, as gift to that woman). As H.Shuaib came to know of the progress of this light, he lost his eyes in his anxiety to see it.

H. Ayub(Job) patiently suffered so many losses and pains for seven years and saw in them opportunities of seeing this light. H.Khizr and H.Ilyas drank the wine of this light and through it the life-giving-water, and became immortal. (H.Ilyas appointed H.Alyasa’a as his vicegerent and vanished; and H.Khizr is a living person for ever on earth). When H.Isa (Jesus) found the ladder of this light, he climbed upon the fourth heaven.

sections.heading: H.Muhammad’s Companions and Followers:
paras: When H.Muhammad got the country and the wealth of that light, he made the moon split into two. When Abu Bakr got support of this light, he became a symbol of God’s support so as to to approve and certify the truth of the king, (H.Muhammad) and became Siddiiq. As H.Umar became lover of the light of his beloved H.Muhammad he found out the truth and falsity of matters and became a differentiator (Faaruuq). As H.Usman was an observant of this light, his light became a dispenser of light and one possessor of two lights(Zunnuurain) having married the Prophet's daughters, H.Ruqyah and H.UmmeKulsum in succession. When Ali Murtaza became the scatterer of the pearls with this light, he became a lion of God in the forest of life. This light of Murtaza came to the Prophet’s grandchildren, who became two pearls and two earrings for the empyrean (Arsh). One of them lost his life with poison and the other one offered his head in full inebriation of faith. As the grandchildren were aware of the secrets of this light, they became the central aspects of the Arsh. These two clean grandchildren, H.Hassan and H.Hussain are the earrings of the ever-living Arsh of grace and grants.

sections.heading: Chain of saints(Aulia):
paras: H.Junaid saw the support given by this light. His states went beyond numbers. H.Bayazid found the path in the excessiveness of this light and got the title of Qutbul Arifun (pole of the gnostics). As H.Ma‘roof Karkhi would remain awake for the whole night in the remembrance of God, he was called as a “town guard, God’s vicegerent and breath of God”. H.Ibrahim son of Ad-ham, king of Balkh gave up his kingdom, became a disciple of H.Imam Abu Hanifa, and a king of the kings of justice. H.Shaqiiq, a rich merchant from Balkh discarded his business, became a student of H.Imam Abu Yusuf, and followed the strange path, as a result of which he became bright like the sun in wisdom with sharp sight and opinions. Then H.Fudhail, who had a profession of dacoity by putting on the apparels of the sufis to cheat victims, gave up all these, when he got blessings and guidance from that light. H.Bishar Haafi, the bare-footed, became a great saint and the announcer of good news and roamed about in the forest and became like a sugar factory for the sweetness of his character. H.Sari Saqati, the scrap dealer fell on the path of annihilation in the love of God and got elevated to the level of the kings in honour.

sections.heading: Names of Saints, Hidden by God:
paras: In every period, the consonance and mercy of God is atop the lives and souls of these clean people.Hundreds of thousands of great kings on the path of the gnosis of God have been blessed by God, whose names, God keeps hidden from the people to protect them from their jealousy. Saints also have not exposed their names. I swear upon their truthful names and their truthful lights. They are like fishes in the ocean which cannot live out of water. They cannot remain without being sunk in the water of God’s gnosis. Even if I call them as the attributes of God, ocean of light, the ocean of soul and soul of the ocean, it would not explain fully. I have to search for another name. The truth is that His property cannot be pointed out as this and that. All things in the universe are like the rind in relationship with the pulp.

The slave concluded: “The qualities of my friend are a hundred times more than what I have explained. O generous king, I cannot explain to you his good qualities I know, because, I am sure you will not believe them.”

sections.heading: Deeds Needed for Human Soul:
paras: The king said: “Now, you may speak about yourself. How long would you say about this man and that man? Tell me as to what you have and what you have achieved. What pearls you have brought up from the floor of the sea.

“All your senses would be dead on the day of your death. You have also got with you the light of the soul, which is a friend of heart. The grave will fill the eyes with mud and darken everything. Tell me, whether you have anything that would brighten the grave. My close friend, the light of the heart is from the soul. Do not arrogantly say that it is a borrowed thing. At the time when the parts of your body turn into pieces, do you have any feathers and wings for the soul to fly with?. At the time when the biological soul passes away, the ever-living human soul has to be replaced. The meaning of the words “Man jaa‘a” in the ayat of the Qur'ān is not ‘who brought’ but “taking it into the river of good deeds”!. The ayat says: He who does good shall have ten times as much to his credit: “Man jaa‘a bil hasanati falahu ashru amth(s)aliha”: (An’am: 6: 160)

sections.heading: Jowhar and ‘Ardh (Substance and Accidents):
paras: Do you possess man’s substance (jowhar) which subsists independently on its own, or you are simply a donkey? Your prayers and salat are not independent substances which subsist on their own, but accidents (‘ardh) which subsist on something else( like a sheet of cloth is Jowhar (substance) and a drawing made on it is an accident, which cannot exist without the sheet of cloth. Your salat and fasting are accidents and you are the substance (Jowhar). When you are no more and gone, your salat and fastings also go away. There are no salats and fastings without you.

“The accidents of salat and fasting do not remain in both the worlds, as such they are lost, (along with you). Accidents cannot be transferred, but they can remove the sickness of the substance of man. These accidents can bring about changes in the substance, just as regimen removes sickness. Therefore, ignore the regimen of accident and try to hold on to the substance to complete your process. A bitter pill removes the sickness and gives sweetness to the mouth with regimen.

sections.heading: Examples of Substances and Accidents:
paras: “With agriculture, mud became a stalk of the plant. Earth is a substance, agriculture is an accident. Manure increases the strength of the stalk and converts it into an ear of corn.Marriage with a woman is an accident, the child born out of it is a substance that comes out of it. Bringing together the male and female of the camels and horses is an accident, the expectant calf is the substance. Making a garden is a substance and getting flowers is an accident. Consider a chemical reaction also as an accident, which results in the product of reaction as substance, which passes from his hand to the hand of his friend. Sharpening and polishing the sword is an accident, an accident that brings about sharpness of the substance. Therefore, do not tell me as to what actions you have done and what you have achieved. These acts as accidents will not be presented before God but only the substance (soul) will be presented. Produce before God the product of these accidents (the soul) and do not run away from this reality. Achievements of all these things are only accidents. We should not bother about them.It is the sacrifice of the sheep that is acceptable and not that of its shadow. Do not sacrifice the shadow”.

The slave said: “O king! Wisdom is always accompanied with despair because of which you say that accidents are not transferred. Having such a belief brings about nothing but despair. In such a case, man has nothing but disappointment if he is told that the accident that has gone away cannot return. If there is no transfer of accident and its collection together with substance, then doing any act becomes useless and telling to do that would be just like a worthless rind.

sections.heading: When and How Accidents Become Substances:
paras: “These accidents get transferred in a different way. Every destructible thing gets into another form or in another life, or gets converted into another kind of substance. The transfer of everything is in accordance with its suitability.The caretaker of the camel is different from that of the sheep. During the doomsday every accident (prayer, fasting) will have a different shape and form. It will assume the form of a substance at the appropriate appointed time. You may see this within yourself that you were initially an accident. Every couple had a movement of desire for each other. The coming together of the father and mother is an accident and the resultant child is a substance. An action becomes a substance.

sections.heading: Ideas and Designs in Mind Are Accidents:
paras: “Look at the palaces and houses in the cities. They were like stories in the mind of the engineers, which resulted in the form of substantial buildings. The engineer thinks that such and such a house that I had seen was very beautiful with a very well designed courtyard, hall and suitable doors. These thoughts of the engineer are his accidents, which brought the required materials and timber from the forest to build the house. What Is the base and capital of every profession? It is nothing but thought or design in the mind as an accident. Whatever we imagine is also an accident.

“If you look at the different things of the world without prior conclusions, you will see them initially as accidents. First came the thought which later resulted in action. The foundation of the universe may also be thought about like this.

“Fruits of actions come to the mind first and they appear in the end in actual practice. The initial work you do for fruits is planting the tree, as though you read the first letter in the end. Though the branches, leaves and roots come prior to the fruits, they are all sent earlier for the formation of the fruits. The leader that was appointed for the universe was the master of “low laaka”, that is, Prophet Muhammad, who came in the end (This is based on Qudsi hadith(s): low laaka lama khalaqtul aflaaka: Had it not been for you I would not have created the heavens.)

sections.heading: Accidents Become Substances:
paras: “These arguments and words are the writings of accidents, which were initially thoughts, now having taken the shape of words. The stories of lions and jackals were initially as accidents in the minds. The entire universe was initially an accident. You can see this in the meaning of Hal ataa. The Qur'ān says: had there not been over man a long period of time when he was nothing (not even) mentioned?: “Hal ataa alal insaani hinum minal dahri lam yakun shaian mazkuran”: (Dahr or Time: 76: 1)

These things that have taken shape are born as accidents, out of a world of ideas, which were borne out of thoughts. This entire world is a thought of the wisdom in entirety of God (Aql-e-kul).Wisdom is like the king and thought is like its ambassador.

sections.heading: Substances and Accidents Interchangeable:
paras: “This first world is a world of trial and the next world is the product of it's this and that. O master, your servant shows dishonesty which is an accident, which later gets converted into prison as punishment. When your servant renders good service, it is an accident. Does it not take the shape of a grant for his achievements? The accidents and substances are like egg and chicken which are in continuing creation. This comes from that, and that comes from this. Therefore to say that accidents are not transferable is incorrect”.
The king said: “Alright, let us agree that accidents become substances. Have any of your accidents become substances?”

sections.heading: Why Secrecy of Results:
paras: The slave replied: “God has kept this as a secret.Accidents (acts of men) are not presented before the world as substances, so that the reality of good and bad may remain hidden in the world. Otherwise, this world will be one of results and not of trial. If all that occurs in the minds were to take shapes, both the faithful and unbelievers would have not done anything other than the remembrance of God. O King, the master of faith, everything would be clear and open and not hidden, in which case the symbols of faith and infidelity would have been marked on the foreheads. In such a case where would be the idols and Idol makers? Who would have dared to laugh and ridicule the other? This world itself would have become doomsday as an event of the judgement of good and bad. In such a case there would be no need for doomsday. Further, doomsday is not an event of action but of judgement. Nobody can do any right or wrong on doomsday. Everyone has to be only obedient, surrendering all his capacities.”

The king said: “Of course, God has kept hidden in the punishment of wrong from the common people, but it cannot be so with his special devoted servants. If I put a minister of mine on punishment, I shall hide it from other ministers and not from the Prime Minister. God has clearly kept the matters of reward and punishment before me, (taking me as one of elevated state). I feel, He has shown me the form of the shapes of actions of thousands of actions.You may cite to me the products of your achievements so that I may know everything of yours. Clouds cannot hide the moon from me”.
The slave said: “Such being the case, what is the good of my telling all that, when you know what kind of an action and achievement was mine?”

sections.heading: Wisdom Behind Creation:
paras: The king said: “The wisdom behind the creation of this world by God is to bring to actual observation of what all is known to God. So long as God did not bring into existence all that was known to Him. He did not impose the labour pain and other pains upon it. You cannot sit idle for any time without doing some good or bad act or the other. These demands have been imposed upon you in order to know your ability to act and reveal your secrets. As otherwise, how is it that the spinning wheel of your body is never at rest, and your heart compels you to make it act as per its demand. The spinning wheel of the body never rests because the thread of your heart always keeps turning around.

sections.heading: Causes and Effects of Continuing:
paras: “Your sitting idle is as troublesome to you as the moment of death. You cannot remain without work anytime. Your loss of peace of mind in remaining without work shows your attraction towards activity. Remaining without work is like death for you. Both this and that world create causes and effects. Every cause is a mother of effect.When the effect comes into existence it also becomes a cause, so much so, there are strange causes and effects. These go on from generation to generation. Father is the cause of son and son is the effect. And, this becomes a cause for the grandson and the process goes on. It requires a very bright set of eyes to see all these”.

When the king reached this stage of discussion, it was not known whether he found any symbols of the achievements of the slave which he wanted to find out. The deep-searching king might have found that out. It was not so distant from him to find out. But to explain what it could be; and whether he found out, is beyond our principles to reveal.
By then, the other slave came out of the bathroom and the great king called him towards himself.
Then the king said to him: “May you be healthy and be pleased forever. You are very nice, pleasing and beautiful”.

Then he sent this slave on some job, so as to become aware of the other fellow. He made him sit before him with honour and respect and then said: “O moon in the darkness, your face is moonlike, your hairs are curly and fragrant with musk; you are of very good conduct, character and behaviour. With all this, how good it would have been if you did not have those things in you of which the other fellow spoke. Anybody looking at you would be highly pleased. Looking at you would be worth the rule of the whole world”.
The slave said: “Please give hints to me O king, of a little of what that loser of faith said about me.”
The king said: “First he said about your being a man of two faces— “one apparent as medicine and the other one of hidden pain.”

When he heard about the ill-feelings of his friend, the river of his anger suddenly turned into a flood.Froth started flowing from his mouth, his face turned red to such an extent that his passion for his condemnation went beyond limits saying: “From the moment he came closer to me, he was like a hungry dog during famine which starts eating filth.”

When he went on abusing him like the constant ringing of a bell, the king kept his finger on his lips saying: “Know this, I have come to know of you and of him. Your soul is foul but his mouth is foul. Therefore, you with a dirty soul may sit at a distance from me, so that he may be a commander and you a commanded one.”

sections.heading: Worth Is Inner, Not Apparent:
paras: “That is what great men of the world have said, that man's comfort comes about with the control of the tongue. It is said in a Hadith(s): ‘an ostentatious recitation of God's names on a rosary is like the greenery of the garbage pit’. Be sure to know that a beautiful face with bad conduct is not worth four grains of corn. You may give up your life under the feet of a man of good conduct even with an ugly and unappealing face. Know that the visible face gets destroyed but the hidden beauty remains forever. Tell me, for how long you will be in love with a face? Become a seeker of good conduct and hidden qualities. How long do you love the water pot appreciating its external paintings and carvings? Stop looking at them and go after water. You have seen only the oyster and ignored its contents. Go after the pearl inside, if you have any wisdom.

“Do not these bodies of the oysters have life within them, because of their existence in the ocean of life given by God? Yet every oyster does not contain a pearl. Therefore, look into every oyster with your own eyes, to see what each of it contains, as a precious pearl is very rarely found.

sections.heading: Inner Mightier Than Apparent:
paras: “If you go after the visible faculties, you may see that a hill is many hundred times larger than a ruby in size. Further, your hands, legs and hair are many times larger in size than your eyes. You should not keep this fact out of mind that the two eyes are superior to these parts. A single thought that comes into the mind becomes the cause of the upsetting of a thousand words in a moment’s time. The king's body is alone to look at but an army of thousands runs with him. Again the body and face of the things are subordinate to hidden thoughts. Consider that with a single intention of God, creatures of all types in countless numbers are spread over the world like flood. Though that intention is but tiny in people's views, but like a deluge it destroys the world. People of the world are all like a herd of animals and God is like the shepherd, who is making them run helter-skelter day and night.

“Thus, you see that with one intention of God, everything is well settled. All houses, palaces, cities, mountains, forests, rivers, earth, oceans, sun, skies are all intact and living because of Him like the fish in water. But for a blind man like you in foolishness, the body is like the Great Sulaiman and the intention is tiny like the ant. In your sight, the mountain is large, – Intention is small like a goat and mountain is a large wolf. This world is frightening and large for you. You fear and shiver with the cloud, lightning and thunder. But in the world of thoughts, you are lesser than an ass like a lifeless rock full of ignorance and contentment. That is because you are like a picture which has no wisdom. You do not have manly character, but only of a baby donkey. You have ignorance in full, totally devoid of sense. You have not even smelt of God. You are mad.

sections.heading: Inner Forces Control:
paras: “With your lack of wisdom, you consider the shadow as a real existence, which is like a worthless game animal. You may see that man goes after non-existents, due to his ignorance of realities.

“Look at the fire. It is a model from the world of non-material existence. It is so subtle, fine, appealing and flying. But, until it comes into contact with a physical body, it remains visible to the eyes.It is just invisible energy. But in effectiveness it is far ahead of itself. It is more effective than thousands of swords and axes, causing great destructions to forests. The intentions and thoughts of God which are not visible to you, will one day open their feathers and wings and become clearly visible to you.Wait till then. You will see mountains flying like soft carded wool and this hot and cold earth will be no more. You will not see the sky, stars and any other existent. You will see nothing but the Everliving, Unique and Loving God”.
This story is narrated here for the purpose of this explanation. This may be true or imaginary but it can promote truthfulness.

A king had preferred a slave to the other slaves with his grace and generosity.His salary was equal to that of forty officers. Even a hundred ministers had not seen one tenth of his status. In the perfectness of his acceptability, fortune and prosperity, he was like the famous Ayaz with Sultan Mahmood of Ghazani. His soul from its base itself, that is, from the world of spirits, was connected with the soul of the king. That is to say, earlier to the time when they had assumed different human forms.

sections.heading: Man's Fate Already Decided:
paras: The reality of men is that which comes about well before his taking a physical form. Those relations that come to him later after his taking a form, are new and adopted. One who knows the realities of things from their bases themselves sees all these clearly. He looks at the farmland as the producer of crops, and finds no difference between the land and crops, and takes both as one, as against a squint-eyed person, who sees them as two and different from each other. Those who have sowed wheat and those who have sowed maize would be looking for the crops day and night. Good acts result in good outcomes and bad acts result in bad outcomes. The night did not deliver anything other than what she became pregnant with. All attempts and efforts are of no use. What has to come about will come about. One’s plans and designs are upset upon seeing that the designs of God as already decided have impacted. He is caught in the net of God and his attempts to get out of it result in further nets. You will see that he gets out neither from this side nor from that side. Howsoever seeds of different grades he may throw, only, what has been thrown by God alone comes up. You put a new crop on the old one; your new crop gets spoiled and the earlier one grows. The first seed is perfect and selected one, the latter one is rotten and lifeless. Thus, God's designs are dominant upon ours.

sections.heading: God’s Decisions Are Final:
paras: Therefore, place your design before God for approval even though your design itself comes from Him only. Only that job is right which is performed by God. And also, only that crop comes about which was sowed first. Whatever has to be sowed by you, may be sowed for Him, when you feel yourself to be bound by Him. Do not wrap up His job with a wrapping provided by your stealthy vicious self. Do not put wrappers upon wrappers to hide that nightly thief of self and get disgraced on the doomsday. Whatever has been stolen by him and collected treacherously will be tied to his neck.

Hundreds of thousands of wise people join together to resort to get means and measures to counter the decisions of fate. They find the net of their fate becoming stronger. Their efforts are like a scrap before the wind. If you do not believe in what I say, you may see in the Qur'ān “Wallahu khairul makireen'': God is the best of schemers. (Al-Imran: 3: 54).

sections.heading: There Is World of Efforts Too:
paras: If you say as to what is the good of life when it is said that efforts are useless before fate, I would ask you as to what is the good of your asking this question. If there is no good in asking this question by you, there is no good in finding the answers to a meaningless question. I need not hear your argument. On the contrary, if your question is good and profitable, you may think that the world of efforts will certainly be useful as the world of efforts is also a creation of God and has its own profits. Your question is worthy of discussion. It is good to discuss over profitable things. And, if there are many gains from your question, not just one, then let everyone else also search for the gains from the world of efforts. Your question, of course, points out towards many benefits. Then the world of efforts cannot be useless. It is not necessary that everything should be useful in all the ways. If the world of efforts is useless in one way as against the world of fate, still it has many collateral benefits. If what is beneficial to you is not beneficial to me, you may go forward to seek your benefits. Do not go away from the effort just because it is of no benefit to me. A thing need not be good for all. You should hold on to it on the basis of the gains you get. You may see that the beauty of H.Yusuf was pleasing to the entire world even though it was totally useless for his brothers. H.Dawood’s songs were very dear to others and birds but they were disliked by those infidels deprived of the taste. River Nile's water was better than the life giving water but for the Coptic rejectors it was blood. For a mu’min who dies in the path of God it is life, but for the hypocrite, it is simply death and destruction.

sections.heading: Good for Some, Bad for Others:
paras: Tell me of a grant of which some people or the other are not deprived. What benefit do the cows and donkeys have in sugar? Every animal has a particular food for itself. Some foods are eaten for short periods against their usual requirement. They will give them up if they are advised, and resort to their regular food habits. Some people resort to eating clay due to some sickness under the wrong impression that it is food. They forget their natural and basic food and continue to eat clay even after recovery from sickness which spoils their health permanently. They ignore honey and eat poison.
