Sickness makes them thin like dry wood.

sections.heading: Real Food of God’s Friends:
paras: The real food of man is the light of God. Food meant for animals is not suitable for man. But because of a sickness similar to that of a clay-eater, one gets into another sickness which makes one eat the products of mud and water, instead of eating mud directly. This sickness makes his face pale, weakens his legs and heart. He has no food from the paths provided by heaven, upon which God swears to confirm its reality and might, saying: “Wa alssaamaii zaatil hubuk”: By the sky with its numerous paths: ( Quran Al Zaariat: 51: 7)

That is the food of the special men of God which is consumed without the plates and mouths. The food of the sun is the light from the arsh. The food of the satans and the jealous is the smoke of the earth. God has said “yurzaquun”: “They find their sustenance” about the shaheeds who die in his path; Ney, they live, finding their sustenance in the presence of their Lord: “Bal ahyaahun inda rabbihim yurzaqun”: (Quran Al Imran: 3: 169). Their food needs neither plates nor mouths to eat.

sections.heading: Togetherness Gives Greater Force:
paras: Heart gets food from every beloved thing. Heart gets cleanliness from every heart. The face of every man is like a bowl and his eyes are capable of recognizing the inside of everything with inner sight (baseerat). You can get something by looking at everyone’s face and also by meeting with any nearby ones. When one star goes nearer to another, the impact of both of them together will be stronger than that of one each. The coming together of man and woman increases progeny and upon coming together of iron and stone, sparks come about. With the mingling of water and earth, fruits, vegetables and fragrant grasses come about. When man mingles with greenery, he gets pleasures of the heart, forgets sorrows and enjoys freshness. When happiness mingles with our soul, we get greater abilities and achievements. Our bodies become stronger to eat and meet the objects of our comforts.

The coming of the blood towards the face provides redness to it and gives a pleasure with which blood becomes redder and brighter as though from the sunlight of joys. The best of the colours is red which is caused by the sun and is from it. That part of the land that comes nearer to Saturn and faces it, becomes infertile spoiling the scope for farming. Power comes to the jobs by the coming together of the people, like the Satan’s going together with the hypocrites. The words of wisdom come from the ninth heaven which has no apparent grandeur and greatness. Man should establish connection with this to become grand and great. [The ninth heaven, which is the top-most heaven is called as empyrean (‘arsh) by the exegesists of the word; philosophers call it the sky of the heavens and also as blank heaven or empty space. There are no stars in this. Sufis consider this as the place from which sciences and informations about God come down to us. [As explained by Math(s)navi's Urdu translator, Qazi Sajjad Hussai]. Achievement of greatness of ordinary people is temporary as it relates to a temporary destructible, physical world (Naasoot). The greatness of the world of commands (‘Alam-e-Amr) is real and everlasting. The great man undergoes all kinds of troubles in order to get greatness and grandeur, from it. They face disgraces happily in the hope of getting graced later. But ordinary people worry themselves for the worldly ten days, bending their necks in worries like the spokes of the spinning wheel. Why do they not come in the place where I am, as I have been honoured as the bright sun. The sun rises from the east of the dark home of sky. But our sun is beyond and above the easts. When we attribute “east” to the case of God, we mean the place from where his friends (Auliya) receive particles of His light, as otherwise, His essence neither rises nor sets. It is the same in every time and place. It is always shedding light. It is we, who sometimes remain behind in receiving His light. Otherwise, He is an evershining sun without any shadow in both the worlds.

sections.heading: Despair Also Blesses:
paras: In spite of all this, it is very strange that I find myself moving around the sun. This makes me believe that this moving is also a grant of glory and grandeur from that sun, and it is to drag me nearer. This Sun is aware of the causes for this movement and when the rope of these causes snaps, it is also from His side. That is to say: I'm made to move around and also to stop the movement. Providing or not providing the causes are from Him alone. Hundreds of thousands of times, I found myself to have lost hopes of this Sun. But be sure to know that this loss has not caused any slackness in my search and observance. This is impossible, just as it is impossible for the fish to remain content without water. It remains attached to water and when it is deprived of it, it ceases to exist. Even if my loss of hope is considered to be confirmed beyond doubt, may it be known that this is also from the Sun and not my making. When the loss of hope is also from Him, this becomes all the more worthy as it is from Him.

sections.heading: Blind to Realities:
paras: Work can never be separated from the worker. How can an existent seek provision from non-existent. All existants receive their provisions from His garden, whether they are good or bad or like burraaqs of lightning speed, fast horses or slow donkeys. But a blind horse grazes on grass blindly. It does not see the garden and its beauty and remains away from the realities of the garden. It merely gets food and nothing else.

A person who does not look at the Causer of the movements of the ocean, considers the movements themselves as the causer, and turns and falls before every movement. He drinks saltish water from an ocean of sweet water to such an extent that saltish water makes him blind. The ocean tells him to drink water with his right hand so that it may brighten his blind eyes. By right hand here is meant proper belief so that he may know what is right and what is wrong. A spear is turned around by someone. It does not turn on its own. It is straight at one time and bent at another (Similarly man is straight at one time and crooked at another). I am helpless in the love of my master, Shams Tabrizi, as otherwise I would have brightened the eyes of that blind rejector to look at his greatness. However, I do permit my disciple Zia ul Haqq Husamuddin to set right the eye-sight of the jealous. You may brighten the eyes of all the blind. You are a fruit bearing tree and therefore drop the fruits. You are a fast working eyeblack, a destroyer of darkness. You have the medicine, which, if applied to the eyes of the blind (unbeliever), it would cure his hundred year old blindness. You may give treatment to the eyes of every blind person but not to the jealous, as he would refuse to take the medicine from you out of his jealousy for you. A jealous fellow cannot be cured even if he is me. Do not give life to him(or me) and allow him (me) to be always injurious to his (my) soul.

Jealousy in such blindness which makes one to refuse to accept the brightness of the sun. Jealousy is an incurable disease and a jealous puts himself into a deep well forever. He is a fellow who desires to annihilate the sun. Just think how that can be possible. The falcon is that which comes back to the king and that falcon that has lost its path is a blind one.

A falcon fell into the colony of owls in a ruin. He forgot the way and came down here. With the blessings of God, he was full of light from head to tail. But the soldier of fate blinded him. Fate threw dust into his eyes and put him away from his path, and dropped him among the owls in a ruin. The owls started hitting him on his head with their beaks plucking his well kept hairs and feathers. There was a great cry among the owls.” Be careful! The falcon has come to occupy our place”.

They pounced upon its like the enraged street dogs that pounce upon the torne clothes of a stranger. The falcon said:” What have I got to do with the owls? I have left a hundred ruins like this for the owls. I am not prepared to live here; I am going back to my king. O owls, do not kill yourselves. I am not going to be here. I am going to my native place. This ruin is like a well established place in your view, but the place for me to sit is on the wrist of the king.”

sections.heading: Lowly and the Wise:
paras: One of the owls said:” The falcon is playing a trick to uproot you from your place of residence and occupation.He wants to occupy our houses and chase us away from our nests with his tricks. He poses himself to be quite well fed, but I swear he is more greedy than all the others.He will lick the mud taking it as grape-juice.O my friends, do not leave the lamb with the wolf. He is boasting of his companionship with the king and king’s wrist in order to misguide simpletons like us. What has this mean bird to do with the king? Do not hear his words, even if you have a little wisdom. Whether he is worthy for the king or for the vazir; can garlic ever be fit to be mixed with the sweet dish prepared with almonds? He is only telling out of treachery, cunningness and cleverness, that the king is searching for him along with the army. This is a strange madness. This is only a baseless boasting and a net to capture innocent ones. Whoever believes in this is a fool. How can a weak tiny bird be worthy for a king? Even if the smallest of us can strike its beak on his brain, where is the question of his friendship with the king”.

sections.heading: Difficult to Understand Nobility:
paras: The falcon said: “ If you snatch even a single feather of mine or you hit me angrily with the petal of a flower, the king will uproot the garden of the owls and destroy all your nests. What after all is an owl? Even if another falcon hurts my feelings and shows cruelty to me, the king will destroy hundred thousand heaps of crops of the falcons in all vales and dales. The king’s benevolences for me are my guards. Wherever I go, the king follows me. Thoughts about me are settled in the heart of the king. Without thinking of me the king feels himself sick.

“When the king makes me fly in any place, I feel a fresh life within myself in the heights of flights. I fly far away like the sun and the moon. I tear the curtains of the sky. The light of the wisdom is because of me. Splitting of the sky is because of my birth. I am a falcon, and Huma [the legendary bird of royal fortune] is amazed at my affairs. What after all is an owl to understand my secrets. The King, out of his concern for me thought of me and freed hundreds of thousands of prisoners. He put me in the company of owls for a moment in order to make them falcons like me with my breaths.

sections.heading: Good Will Not Ignore Good:
paras: “That owl is fortunate which found out my secrets in my flight. Join my company so as to become falcons like me. Become falcons like me and give up your owlish conduct. One who is beloved of such a king will not be a stranger in any place, wherever he may go. One for whose pain the king is the remedy, will not remain without support, even if he cries sweetly like the flute. I am the master of the country. I am not a greedy eater. The king is beating drums all around the country from border to border to call me back. The beating of drums is a call for me like the call by God to His noble spirited bondsmen as stated in the Quran: “You may come back to your Lord well pleased, and well pleased unto Him”: “Irji’ii ilaa rabbiki radhiyatan mardhiyyatan”(Fajr 89: 28)

“God is a witness upon the disgrace of my enemies. I am not similar to the king; I am entirely different from him, but in the matter of possessing radiance, I am like him. Having a similar face and body is not a matter of similarity but the inner qualities of affinity for each other are just as water becomes similar in action to clay to bring up crops.

Fire is similar to air in its physical form as it also has no body and shape and it co-exists with air. It cannot exist without air, and is put out without it. Wine has some similarity with the character of a cowardly dull man, but after getting into him, it makes him active and smart. Our qualities are not like those of our King but our existence can be annihilated into Him. When I get my existence lost in Him, only He is left and I am just like the dust moving around the feet of His horse. Our life becomes dust and its marks are left on the dust of His feet. Become like the dust of His feet so that you may become the crown upon the heads of great rulers and emperors.

sections.heading: Apparent Things Misguide:
paras: Do not be under the wrong impression about my face. Have a taste of my snacks, before my death. Be it known that many persons lost their path of intelligence by confining themselves to the apparent shapes, and thought of harming that face; and by doing so they attacked God. After all the soul is mixed up with the body, but you do not see the soul as similar to the body. Therefore, there is no need to reject the connections on the basis of lack of apparent similarity. Eyesight is connected with the fat in the eye, and the light of the heart is hidden in a drop of blood. Happiness and kidney, sorrow and liver, lamp of wisdom and brain, are not similar but interconnected. Smelling capacity is in the nose and speech is in the tongue. Pleasure is felt by the conscious self and bravery is found in the heart. These connections (are felt) but cannot be explained. They cannot be perfectly exemplified. Our wisdoms are incapable of understanding their qualities. All these cannot be satisfactorily explained. When this is so with these connections, it is impossible to explain the connections of God with creations.

sections.heading: Worlds of Spirit:
paras: The life in entirety is of God but has impacted upon the partial lives of creatures. Partial lives collected the pearls from Him and put them in their pockets. There was an impact upon the heart of H.Maryam (Mary) as a result of which she became pregnant with H.Īsa Masih. He is not that Masih who simply reigns upon the continents and oceans. He is above all that and beyond any special measurements and weights. He is beyond our calculative talents. He is not the spirit of himself alone but the spirit of all the spirits. When life receives that spirit from God, the spirit of spirits, it becomes pregnant with such spirit, which fills the entire world with spirit. This new world of spirits gives birth to another world of spirits which creates a turmoil like that of the doomsday. In this manner, the world of spirits creates so many doomsday-like turmoils which I am unable to explain. If I try to explain these doomsdays ensuing upto the last and final doomsday, I would be absolutely incapable.

sections.heading: Conversation with God:
paras: These statements of wisdom that came from the great men appointed by God to explain are similar to the prayers and addresses to God such as to say: O my Lord(Ya Rabb). These worlds of ‘Ya Rabb’ are like the sweet magic spells coming from sweet lips. Why should then one be silent in saying so and be negligent. This “ Ya Rabb” is producing a response of Labbaika from the lord. (Labbaika means yes, I am here; I am present at your call; I am attentive to you). In this manner saying ‘Ya Rabb’ starts a conversation with God. This is the manner with which man starts conversation with God and makes God talk to him. But this ‘labbaika’ cannot be heard by the ear, but you can feel the taste of it from head to toe. I can give an example in this regard to you to know about this so that you may eat the fruit of labbaika.

There was a high wall in the bank of a stream and a thirsty man in distress was sitting atop the wall. He was extremely thirsty searching for water, weak and distressed like a man in love having lost self control, and in amazement. The wall was a block for him to go upto water. He was like a fish out of water in a highly troubled state. This wall came in the way of his going toward water; but his painful lamentations were reaching the heavens.

Suddenly, he threw a brick on water and heard the sound of water as a calling like the sweet, tasteful words of a friend.This sound caused a wine- like- intoxication in him, just as the sound of ‘labbaika’ for a lover. With the clear sound of water, that man in distress became a remover of brick from its place from the wall and its thrower. The water called him and asked him: “ What did you get by beating me with a brick?”.

sections.heading: Inaudible Sounds and Responses:
paras: The thirsty man said: ”O water, I got two things from this work. I shall never give up this work. The first gain is the hearing of the sound of water which is like the thunders of the clouds for the thirsty. Its sound gives a new life to the garden in the form of spring season. It is like the calling of Israfil which gives life to the dead.Or it is like the sound of thunder in the spring season, through which the garden gets decorations and colours of various types. Or it is like an announcement of the distribution of zakaat which is very pleasant for a beggar; or like a message of release from the prison for a prisoner. Or like the words of God without sound reaching Prophet Muhammad from Yemen as he had said: “I received breath of God from Yemen.” Or it would be like the fragrance of Prophet Muhammad reaching a sinner for his intercession before God. Or like the fine fragrance of H.Yūsuf which put its healthy impacts upon the weakly H.Yakub. Or like the slowly flowing morning breeze from the garden of Daras salaam, that reaches a sinner as relief ( Dras salaam is one of eight states of paradise). Or like the alchemy that touches the blackened copper to convert it into gold. Or, it is like the voice of Laila to be heard by Majnun. Or the voice of Ramin, another beloved like Laila, of the other Arabian lover, Waise.

sections.heading: Slow Removal of Obstacles:
paras: “The other gain for me by removing the brick from the wall is that I am putting the brick towards clean water. Further, with the reduction of each brick from the wall, the wall slowly goes down taking me nearer to water. The removal of each brick becomes the cause of taking me nearer to the meeting of my object. Removing a brick which is attached to another brick, results in the lowering of the wall, and becomes a cause of going nearer to the object. Similarly, if a man forgets his superiority and lowers himself, he goes nearer to God through prostration as stated in the Quran: “Bow down in adoration and bring yourself closer to God”: “Wasjud waq tarib”: (Iqra 96: 19). So long as this wall is high, it has an arrogant neck that does not allow it to lower its head. God is the life- giving- water. And nobody can fall in prostration before Him, so long as he does not clean himself of the mud of his body like the removal of the bricks of the wall. The more thirsty one sits on the wall, the faster he will pluck and remove bricks and mud from the wall. Whoever is in greater love with the sound of water will remove more and more of the lumps of mud to facilitate greater closeness. With the sound of water, he is as though full up to his throat with wine and not prepared to hear any sound other than of gulping.”

sections.heading: Blossoms of Youth:
paras: My dear, he is very fortunate, who considers the youthful days of his life as very valuable and gets rid of the debts of his life. He is very strong of body and heart, and healthy during the times of his authority and power. And the stage of youthfulness provides its fruits and gifts, as it is like a green and well developed garden. Strength and vitality sprout during these days like streams and provide greenery to the lands of the body. The house is full of residents in peace with an elevated roof and clean with strong pillars. Brightness of the eyes and strength of the body are strong enough like a strong fort. The house of the body is bright and clean. Therefore, my dear, consider youthfulness as a great gift, keep your head down in obedience and remove the bricks and lumps of mud obstructing your ways.

sections.heading: Problems of Old Age:
paras: Well before the arrival of old age in your bodily home, when your neck will be tied with the rope of pricking fibers of palm leaves: “hablin min masad”: (Lahab: 111: 5). The clay of the body becomes barren, loose and useless.. Barren land never gives rise to any kind of good plants. The water of strength and vitality is cut off from the body so that it neither gets gain from itself or from others. Eyebrows lower down like the belts of the horse's saddles. Eyes develop glaucoma causing impaired vision. Face develops wrinkles and appears like the back of lizards. Speaking ability goes away, tongue does not feel the taste and teeth become useless. Back bends, heart becomes weak and the entire body becomes forlorn, and hands and legs become thin like thread. He can carry very little luggage and food on journeys. Even his horse gets tired very soon.He remains always sorrowful with weak heart and body. He has no interest in the maintenance of his house, seeking and getting no support for the purpose.The heart continuously cries like the flute attached to a goat- skin filled with air which continuously releases air to create crying sound. Life appears wastful, all efforts useless and the destination far off. All enthusiasm of the soul gets slackened with black heart and impatience. Fear of death makes the hair go white like snow and all parts of the body shiver like leaves. His day has no time to pass, his donkey lame and the way very long, place of work ruined and all acts non-productive. The roots of all old habits become stronger with no strength to uproot them.

This is similar to the case of a hard-hearted man with much talkativeness, who had sown the thorny plant on the road. People moving on the road condemned him for this. And he promised to them that he would pull it out. The plant went on growing day by day and the people’s feet got injured by that. Clothes of the people were getting torne and the poor people were getting injured more and more.

The officer of the place came to know of this vicious act of that troublesome fellow. He warned him to pull out the tree, and he promised him also that he would pull it out. A long period passed in these promises of tomorrow and the day after, and the thorny tree gained more and more strength.

On another day, the officer told him strictly: “O breacher of promises! Do what we have ordered and let there be no more delay.” That fellow said: “Time has created a distance between myself and the tree.” Then the officer again told him: “Do it soon, do not give excuses for our claim. Everytime you say tomorrow. Everyday that comes about makes the thorny tree more and more youthful and its puller becomes older and weaker. The thorny tree is gaining strength and height and the uprooter is becoming tiresome and deficient in power. The thorny tree is becoming fresher and fresher time by time, and day by day, and its uprooter weaker and drier. It is getting youthful and you are becoming older. Do it soon. Do not waste your time anymore.“

sections.heading: Bad Habits: Thorny Bushes:
paras: Consider all your bad habits as thorny trees. Many a times, the thorn has pricked your foot. Many times you have felt ashamed of your acts and come on the stage of anxieties. Many times, you felt yourself injured by your bad habits, but you did not feel anything about them and lost all senses. If you are not aware of the harms caused to others by your bad conduct, it means that you are unconcerned about the pains of others. But you are not unconscious of your pain- inflicting- habits. You are a calamity for yourself and for others.

Either take an axe and hit upon it like a brave man on the roots and pull out the door of Khyber like H. Ali or become one like the soft and kind one like H. Abu Bakr Siddique and H. Umar the Just( and be a model for others in maintaining self control). But be aware, do not follow the ways of others. Or tie up the thorns of bad habits with flowers by developing connections with great men of light. Mix up your fire with their light, so that their light may extinguish your fire. Mixing with them will convert your thorny bushes into a garden of flowers.

sections.heading: Fire Fears the Faithful:
paras: You are like hell and the faithful is like the light. It is possible to extinguish fire through a mu’min. The great Prophet has spoken of the words of hell as saying that it flatters a mu’min because to its own fear. It tells him: “O king, go away from me fast. Look here, your light has extinguished my fire”. Thus, the light of the faithful is a cause of putting out of the fire as it is not possible to eliminate one without another one of opposite nature. On the day of judgement fire will be the opposite of light. It enflames more ferociously. But the mu’min becomes softer with mercy.

If you want to eliminate the mischiefs of the fire of misconduct, you may sprinkle on it the water of mercy. The source of this water of mercy is a Mu’min. His clean and pure soul is life- giving- water. Your vicious soul runs away from him as you are made up of fire and he is a stream of water. Fire runs away from water for the reason that water destroys its heat. All your feelings and thoughts are fiery, but those of your guide are products of light. When the water made of light falls upon fire, continuing pangs of its death come out and it ceases to exist. When you hear its sounds, tell it to die along with its burning power, so that the fire of the hell of yourself may cool so also that it may not burn your garden and reduce your sense of justice and kindness. So that it may also destroy the fire of your sins. Some sins have so much fire in them that they can set fire to thousands of gardens. When such sins are burnt down, the soil of your soul becomes clean. Whatever that you sow in this cleansed soil will grow well. You get varieties of flowers and fragrant grasses.

sections.heading: Wise, Semi-Wise and Foolish Fish:
paras: We had been moving on a broadway but we have gone away from it with the digressions of our thoughts. Come, let us put ourselves on the true path again. Before this digression, we were talking about the one in losses whose donkey is lame and the destination far off. You have a heavy load and there is a well on the way. Do not walk in a crooked manner. The road is wide enough, walk in a straight manner. Sixty years have passed and now there are efforts to catch you in the fishnet. You are saved from it so far. Find out the proper way of escape in water. Looking at this fishnet, the wise fish went down to the floor of water. It escaped from the net and protected itself from being fried on the frying pan. But you did not escape in this manner and the time of escape was over, and got trapped along with another foolish fish. Now, to save yourself, you may remain motionless like a dead fish, when you will be thrown away, as fishermen do not carry dead fishes. After getting thrown, you may move away fast towards the sea. As otherwise, if you try to jump up and down like the third foolish fish it will be taken out of the net and fried. This is the act of the foolish fish. No wiseman will act foolishly and get trapped.

sections.heading: Do Some Good Work Before Death:
paras: The story of that river and the three fishes is narrated to you to learn a lesson from it. Therefore, get up from your unconscious sleep, learn a lesson and find out the proper way. Seek the help of God and go on your object in order to meet it. The sowing season of the year has gone past. There is no scope for sowing now. You are now put to shame and do some other unworthy work only. White ants have infested the roots of the tree. The only remedy now left is to set fire to the tree to get rid of white ants. Be careful O journeyman, the time is over. The sun of life is on its way to the pit of the grave. In the leftover two days of life, when there is still some power left, do the jobs of the period of youth in this old age. Sow whatever few seeds that are left with you, so that you may see their leaves and fruits, not now, but after death in your next life. Make a gamble of whatever life is left with you, so that a long life may come with the leftover two breaths. So long as this lamp, spreading gems is not put out, be warned and be fast to provide the oil and wick to it.

sections.heading: Human Body Is a Prison:
paras: Do not say “tomorrow” for any act as many tomorrows have become yesterdays so that the days of sowing season may not be lost. Hear my advice that this human body is a strong prison; go out of it as it has become old, and search for a new one, if you so wish. Your words are of no use. Keep them away and open your hands full of money to scatter them for the use of others in a generous manner. Give up the miserliness of the body which always seeks to protect its possessions by spending all time for itself and not sparing any of it for others to do good acts and godly jobs of generosity. Giving up of the pleasures and passions of the body is generosity, which the body always avoids due to its miserliness. One who is sunk in the pleasures and passions of the body can never come out of it.

sections.heading: Generosity Leads to Paradise:
paras: Generosity is a branch of the tree of paradise as stated by the Prophet; “A generous person holds on to this branch and this branch holds him strongly until it takes him inside the paradise”. It is a pity for one who gives up this branch. Giving up of the passions is the most trustworthy handle: “urvatil wuth(s)qa”: (Baqarah 2: 256) which drags one to heaven. Therefore, O good man, hold on to generosity so that it may take it to its base, the paradise.

sections.heading: Patience Leads to Success:
paras: You are like the beautiful H.Yūsuf and this world is a well in which he was felled. The rope to come out of it is patience upon the decision of God(fate). O Yūsuf, the rope is hanging for you. Hold on to it strongly with both hands. Do not be careless about the rope as time, along with it, will pass off. All praises to God, Who has hanged down the rope due to your repentance and seeking pardon. He has mixed up His mercy and grace together. Hold on to the rope and come out so as to attend to His grand court and see a new world, unseen by you: the new world of souls which is quite clearly visible to the few(elevated ones) and hidden from the rest. This world of materials will not last long but is visible to all, which hides the other invisible world.

sections.heading: Dust Causes confusion:(Basaarat and Baseerat):
paras: There is dust in the world which is dancing and moving about with air. It is showing itself in a wrong manner and hiding the air which moves it. People see only dust but not the air. Dust is only an instrument in the hands of air. Air is superior to dust and is the base of the movements of dust. The eyes of the humans which are made of the dust of earth look only at their originator, the dust. But the eyes that go beyond the dust, earth and materials are of a different type, not made of dust. One who is engaged in only observation is busy with the useless rind ignoring the pulp of the fruit which is the real objective and reality.
Horse is wild without rider:

A horse knows the affairs of another horse as both are like friends. Similarly, the rider knows another rider. The sensory external eyes are like the horse and the light of God is the rider. A horse alone cannot do any work without the rider. Similarly, the external eyes cannot see anything without the guidance of the inner eyes. Rid the horse of bad habits and make it disciplined as otherwise the horse becomes unworthy before the Lord. The eyes of the horse are guided under the eyes of the rider and they are deficient without the rider’s eyes. The eyes of the horse see nothing but grass and grasslands. And, whichever side you drag them, they say: “what for?” The light of God is dominant upon the light of the senses; and if the senses become obedient, you may conclude that the light of God has guided them. The horse does not know anything about roads and the means for going. It is only upon the rider’s wish that it works rightly. Therefore, you may go in that direction which is taken by the rider with the light of God, as that light is very good for you. The light of senses receives its light from the light of God; and it is this light that is called the light upon light: “Nuurun ‘alaa nuur”: (Surah Nur 24: 37). This is the meaning of “light upon light”. The apparent light of the eyes is called basaarat: seeing; the inner light of the heart is called baseerat: seeing the inside of things with the inner eyes of the heart.

sections.heading: Sensory Light and the Spiritual Light (Basaarat and Baseerat):
paras: The sensory light(basaarat) drags towards the earth(matter); and the light of God(baseerat) takes you to the elevated world of the spirits. This is because: the material world is the lower world of senses. And God's light is like the ocean and its sense is like the dew. But the rider on the light of God cannot be seen by the light of the sensory sight. This can be seen in good markings(actions) and good tasks. The sensory light is heavy and thick; and it is hidden from the eyes themselves being hidden from the black pupil of the eyes. When you cannot see this sensory light itself, how can you see that hidden light with your eyes. In Spite of its thickness, when the sensory light of the eyes is hidden and invisible, how can that subtle, hidden, invisible light be seen by the eyes?

This world is like a scrap of grass in the hand of the wind of the invisible spiritual world. It has humbled itself to the wind which comes from the valley of the invisible world. Sometimes, it flies it up and sometimes brings it down. Sometimes, it makes it function well, sometimes it weakens it. It takes on to the right sometimes and to the left at another time. Sometimes, it makes it a garden and sometimes a land of thorny bushes. Sometimes, it takes it to the ocean and sometimes to the continents. Sometimes, it makes it dry and sometimes it makes it wet.

sections.heading: The Unseen Mover (God) Moves:
paras: The hand is hidden, yet you see the pen moving. The horse is running fast without a rider upon it. The arrow is in flight but there is no sight of the bow. Lives are visible but the life giver is not seen. All the arrows of predestination and free will are in flight. Do not break the arrows as these are the arrows of fate. They are not flying aimlessly. They have recognised targets as decided by fate. This is what God meant when He said: “Wamaa ramaita iz ramaita Walakinnallaha ramaa”: (Anfal 8: 17): You did not throw when you threw, but it was God who threw. This refers to prophet Muhammad’s throwing dust upon the enemies during the battle. That is to say that God threw the dust and the Prophet’s hand was His tool. This is a way through which God acts and the acts of men are His acts.

You should not get upset and angry when an arrow of fate attacks you. You should not think of breaking it but of breaking your anger, as what you see with angry looks appears wrong. White milk appears like red blood. Kiss the arrow and go before God, the archer, and take the blood-red arrow before Him. Know that these appearances of acts and objects are weak, helpless and controlled by the Hidden and great-in-might-and power. We are all like game animals caught in His net. We are like the cricket balls and an invisible bat is hitting us and sending us in directions desired by the bat. We are like the fabric, cut, torn and stitched by an invisible tailor. Also like the torch to which the torchman puts oil and sets alight. Sometimes, He makes a rejector of a faithful man and makes a rejector as an obedient, pious fellow. This is because man’s heart is in His hand. He changes it moment by moment.

sections.heading: Great Risks in Search of God:
paras: One who considers oneself as pure and pious is always at risk so long as one does not absolve oneself totally of one’s self. Because, on the way there are innumerable dacoits from whom one cannot protect, except the one who is in God’s protection. There are many risks in the search of God. The mirror of his heart is in the process of polishing. The bird is not yet caught but is only in the process of being caught. When the process of search comes to completion, the searcher finds the object in the place of perfect peace. He attains success.

A mirror does not reconvert to iron; a bread does not turn back to the heap of wheat grains. A ripe grape does not reconvert to rawly. So also other ripe fruits. Therefore, ripen yourself and be away from change to the earlier stage and become bright like the great scholar, researcher and saint Burhanuddin Muhaqqiq.

sections.heading: Instructions Needed from Great Souls:
paras: When you give up your ego, you become like him; and when you say: “I am just a servant engaged in service”, you become great like the king. If you want to see, unseen things, follow the steps of Salahuddin Zarkoob, who had opened the eyes and given light to many. Everybody possessing the light of God found out what faqr (voluntary poverty) is upon his forehead and body. He was active without tools like God and he taught his disciples without giving lessons. Hearts became soft and amenable in his hand. They got the grace of expansion and honour, and removal of constriction under his influence. The marks on his soft seal have such designs which cannot be understood by anybody other than a competent goldsmith, who can be his closest disciple in search. Through this disciple, his teachings go from man to man and the process continues. The sounds of these teachings are audible to some and inaudible to others, in the hillocks of the hearts as echoes. One for whom the sounds are audible becomes a wise master. May he be in these sounds for all the time! These sounds are the products of the impressions of the master which are caused by God. In some hillocks of hearts these sounds echo two times, and in some these hundred times. The hills get excited with these sounds and words, creating hundreds of thousands of fast moving fountains of secrets and wisdom. This process goes on with the blessings of the wise master. When the hillock gets deprived of the pleasures of information about all these secrets and wisdom, the water of the fountains becomes blood. That is, instead of godly thoughts, thoughts of infidelity start coming out.

sections.heading: Noble Intuitions Come from God:
paras: The previous state of noble intuition was from the Emperor's shoe, which had converted Mount Sinai into a ruby. Parts of the mount got life and wisdom from Him. And what a pity that we are proving ourselves to be inferior to the mount. From our soul neither a single fountain sprouts, nor our bodies procure the greenery of godly spring. Neither a lamentation of His love arises from us; and nor even the sound of the gulping of wine to our cup-bearer. We do not have the self respect to crush the mountain of our body with pickaxes and crowbars of prayers and austerities. If we do this and break it into pieces, there is a possibility of the moon shedding its light on the heap, or the rays of the sun may pass through them. When the doomsday uproots the mountains, it is the final end for them. But, well before it we can uproot our mountain and crush it, and still hopes for the parts to come back together under the impacts of the little lights from moon and sun. This is not expected of this mountain on or after the doomsday. We have the power of crushing the mountain of the body. It is no less than the crushing of mountains on doomsday, as this job is also very hard to do: as hard as crushing the mountain with crowbars and pickaxes. There is yet a difference between this and that doomsday; this doomsday has a healing balm, while the other doomsday does not. The one who has found out this healing balm in the form of saintly wisemen has no fear of the wounds inflicted by oneself on the body. Even a bad fellow will become good if he comes to know of this balm.

sections.heading: Companions Bring About Changes:
paras: Know this! That ugly fellow is fortunate who has a beautiful friend and it is a misfortune for a beautiful flower to be in autumn. Beautiful and ugly faces are similar to good and bad manners. Bread has no life. It is dead. But when it is eaten by a living person it gets life; rather it becomes life. Dark fuel upon getting into fire, loses its darkness and becomes light embodied. A dead donkey falling into a salt mine loses its donkeyness and dead state becomes saltish and does not decay.The colour of the pot of God is the colour of God in which different colours mix up and form a single colour with which the leper also loses his white patches and gets this colour, as this is a colour from Allah, and who is better than Allah at colouring?

sections.heading: “Sibghatallah! Wa Man Ahsanu Minallahi Sibghatan”: (Baqarah: 2: 138). If You See Someone Falling into This Pot, Tell Him to Get Up; and He Will Go Euphoric for Losing His Individuality and Getting Mingled with God's Colour and Gets Lost in Himself and Announces:” Do Not Call Me by Name: I Am a Part of God”. His Saying “I Am a Part of God” Is Like Telling: ”I Am the Truth” (Anal Haq), as Was Said by Shaikh Mansoor Hallaaj. He Has the Colour of Fire, Though Not Fire Itself but Only Iron. This Is ”Anal Haq”
Impact of Allah’s Colour:
paras: The colour of iron is lost in the colour of fire. But iron started boasting that it has become fire not by word of mouth but through its body language. This is just a boasting, because the same iron becomes red like gold from gold mine upon further heating but it dare not call itself gold but says only as being fire. It has only attained the glory of the colour and nature of fire, but boastfully says: “I have become fire”. It further boasts: “ You see! I am fire. If you have any doubt on this, come and test me by keeping your hand on me. I do say: I am fire. If you have doubts, come near me and keep your face on me for sometime.”

It also says: “When man gets light from God, he becomes special and one to be prostrated by the angels (as happened in the case of H.Adam). Similarly, he becomes one to be prostrated by others just as the angels did. When his soul is totally rid of self-assertiveness and doubts, it attains godly maintenance of equity. That is to say good people also become worthy of prostration like God”

[The above examples of dark fuel becoming one with fire, donkey becoming like salt, colored with the colour of God claiming to become godly, and iron claiming itself to be fire, and the pious becoming worthy of prostration are given only for the sake of explaining about the confusions of many who compare things with God on the basis of some similarities; and not that Rumi accepted these. This clarification is found in the next following verses. —Translator]

sections.heading: God: Uncomparable:
paras: What is fire and what is iron? Stop these comparisons, do not make fun of the compared things with the one with which compared. How can you compare these incomparables? Essence and attributes of God are not comparable matters, as God is Absolute and absolutely uncomparable. Talking about these matters is like stepping into the sea. The best course in this matter is to bite your own lips and to keep quiet, and simply stand aloof on the sea shore. Such arguments and interpretations should never be resorted to.

Though hundreds like me dare not step into the sea, yet I cannot have patience without diving into the sea of God's essence and attributes. I sacrifice my life and wisdom upon this sea, the compensation for which is given to me by the sea itself. So long as I have the capacity, I shall move my legs, as much as I can; and when the legs are no more capable, I shall surrender to the sea like a duck and be so. As I feel that a bad attendant is better than an absent one. A link of the chain may not be perfect, yet it is with the chain and attached to the door. O the one with a dirty body! Move around the fountain of a guide, as there is a possibility of your getting washed. A clean person who goes away from the fountain will be sure to be rid of his uncleanliness. The cleansing capacity of the fountain has no limits, as the uncleanliness of the ordinary bodies is very light and can be cleansed easily. As the house itself is a clean fountain, with a secret passage toward the sea of cleanliness, this is in need of a guide to pass through. Even one with a clean heart also is in need of a guide, as without support, there is every possibility of its gradual decrease and total loss in due course.
Water called an unclean man to enter into it. The man said: “I am unclean. I am ashamed of water”. Water said: “How can you get rid of the shame without me. How can your uncleanliness go without me”.

sections.heading: No Shyness to Admit Faults:
paras: If every unclean person hides from water, how can he protect his faith, as shyness becomes a cause of deficiency as the Prophet has said: “Shyness is an obstacle for faith”. Therefore, you should not make shyness an obstacle for faith. Heart has become immobile by entangling itself with the muddy base of the body, but the body has become clean with the water of the fountain of heart. Therefore, it is better that one should move around the fountain of heart and be careful not to keep oneself away from the fountain of the body. The seas of the body and heart are mingled up, but there are barriers in between them which they do not transgress as stated in the Quran: Between them is a barrier which they do not transgress: “Bainahuma barzakhul la yabghiyan: (Rahman: 55: 20). Whether you are straight or crippled, go forward and not backwards. Though there is great risk in going before the kings, the brave ones do not hesitate to go. This applies to one going before God. As this King (God) is sweeter than sugar. It is worthwhile even to lose life in going to Him. O hesitant on the path, may peace be upon you; and O the seeker of security and avoider of forward march, your place is only a barren land.

sections.heading: Joys of Sorrows and Pains:
paras: My life is a furnace and is happy with fire; and the satisfaction of the furnace is that it is a house of fire. Like a furnace, the job of love is to burn; and one who has not tasted this fire is ill witted. When non- possession of materials, i.e. annihilation in love becomes your only possession, you actually get an everlasting life without any scope for death. When the garden of your life becomes happy with the flowers of sorrows, sorrows become the cause of your joys. Whatever causes fears to others, becomes a cause of peace for you, just as a duck is happy in water as against a land bird.

O physician, you had cured me; but once again I have gone mad. O my friends, I am entirely mad now. You have kept me in chains to control the impacts of my madness. But all links of your chain are full of mischief and every link creates a new madness for me. Every link gives me an entirely different kind of madness. Instead of controlling, you are increasing my madness every moment. There are different kinds of madnesses, as the saying goes which is accepted by all (Al junuunu funuunun): and in particular the chain that is imposed by the Great Master, God. Yet madness has broken many such chains to such an extent that all mad men have started advising me.

sections.heading: Incompetent Fellows Harass Great Men:
paras: That is what happened with Zunnuun Misri that he got into a new madness and enthusiasm. He got into such a mental turmoil that from high above the heavens there was a sprinkling of salt on the wounds of the liver. Be careful, you are made up of infertile earth. Do not compare your love with those of such high spirited people. People had no strength to bear the impact of his madness, as its fire was burning out their beards, in the sense that those showing their piety with their long beards were getting their false pretensions exposed. As their pretensions were getting exposed, they got him imprisoned to protect their vanities. But they did not know that with this kind of control, it would be impossible to compel the masses to ignore him. This ruling class found that Zunnuun’s madness would cause great danger to them through the common masses. Because, this class was blind without any qualification to rule the people. When decisions are in the hands of the ostentatious people, inevitably men like Zunnuun would be imprisoned.

A great king, Zunnuun was going alone who was like a valuable pearl, which had fallen into the hands of children. It is not just a pearl, but a drop of water holding an ocean within itself or the sun penetrated into a particle. That great pearl showed itself to its sun and slowly opened its mouth in such a way that all particles entered into it wiping it off completely. The world got intoxicated with this and lost senses. This is what happens when people go mad after someone but as the pen was in the hands of anti-people fellows, inevitably such mad men like Mansur had to be hanged. When power had gone into the hands of incompetent fellows, inevitably prophets of God were killed as stated in the Qur’an: They rejected the signs of God and slew the prophets in defiance of right: “kaanoo yakfuroona bi ayaatillaahi wa yaqatuloona ambiyayi bighairil haq”: (Al-Imran 3: 112) The prophets were told by the misguided communities out of their mental hollowness: for us we auger an evil omen: “Inna tatayyarnaabikum”: ( Yasin: 36: 18).

sections.heading: This Is How the Ignorant Fellows Showed Enmity. Now, Come to the Love That the Ignorant People Show. the Ignorant Christians Seek Peace from That Master Jesus Who According to Their Beliefs Was Crucified. but According to Their Belief, When the Jews Got Him Crucified, He Could Not Protect Himself. How Could He Then Be Your Deliverer. When That Great King Zunnuun Was Injured at His Heart, He Could Not Seek the Protection of God as Stated in God’s Address to Prophet Muhammad: but God Was Going to Send Them a Penalty While You Were Amongst Them: “Maa Kaanallahu Liyu’azzibuhum Wa Anta Fiihim”: (Anfal 8: 33). That Is to Say, so Long as the Prophet Was with Them, They Would Not Undergo Any Penalty. This Is Also Applied to Saints. so Also, It Is Applied to Zunnuun Misri. There Is Also a Risk Attached to Gold and the Goldsmith, Which Is More from the Adultrators and Misappropriators
Jealousy Is a Wolf:
paras: Many Yusufs are hidden due to the enmity of the jealous, because they feel as though rolling on the fire of beauties. They are hidden in the wells by the treacheries of their brothers, as they handover Yusufs to the wolves out of their jealousy. They handed over only in their imagination just as a pretext to be placed before their father. It was not the wolf that troubled Yusuf, but the fat mighty wolf of jealousy that was hidden in their hearts. That is why, H.Yakub was always in fear and risk of this hidden wolf. The real-living-wolf did not at all come near H.Yusuf. But the mischief of the wolf of jealousy went beyond the troubles that a real wolf could give. This wolf caused harm to Yusuf and taught an excuse to his brothers to tell H.Yakub: O our father! we went racing with one another: “Ka inna zahabanaa nastabiqu”: (Yusuf: 12: 17). Such a kind of treachery cannot be played by hundreds of wolves. But do not worry! Wait and see: in the end, this wolf will be put to shame, because the jealous will be seen on the doomsday in the form of wolves. Greedy eaters of ill gotten food, will be in the form of dogs/ and pigs. On that day, the genitals of the fornicators will be rotten and foul, and the mouths of the drinkers of liquor will be smelling foul. All the hidden dirt that reaches the hearts will be felt and exposed on the doomsday.

sections.heading: Things Known by Dominant Character:
paras: Man's existence is like in a forest. Be careful and guard yourself in this forest. If the apparent and the hidden are like each other, there is no doubt for anyone to see their results. But there are thousands of wolves and pigs within us, in the form of our character. These are good and bad, virtuous and vicious in us. We identify them on the basis of the dominant character: There is copper also in gold ornaments but as the dominant element is gold, it is called gold. Your fate will be decided on that day on the basis of the dominant factor. Sometimes a man gets possessed by wolfishness and sometimes like the moonlike beauty of H.Yusuf. Good and bad qualities secretly pass from generation to generation.

sections.heading: Not Only That, Even Oxen and Donkeys Become Wise, Knowledgeable and Artistic by Remaining in the Company of Man. a Slow Sluggish Horse Becomes Fast-Running and Obedient. Even the Bear Dances Under Man's Teaching and the Goat Salutes. from Man, Greed and Taste to Work Enters into the Dog, When It Becomes a Shepherd, Hunter or Guard. Under the Impact of the Companions of the Cave (as-Habe Kahf) in Their Sleep, Excellence Went into Their Dog so Much That It Became Desirous of God
paras: In every period of time, a special quality generates in the chest: devilish, angelic, herbivorous and carnivorous making man as such. In this wonderful forest of the man’s breast, every lion-like man finds a hidden path to reach to the heights of the chest.

Therefore, be a thief to steal pearls and carols from the hearts of the gnostics and saints of God. If you are a thief, commit the theft of clean pearls. When you want to carry a burden, carry a burden of virtues.

As Zunnuun went toward the prison with all joy, his feet in chains, he was lost to the people. His friends from all sides went toward the prison to make enquiries. They were all discussing his affairs and about his going to prison asking whether he intentionally behaved like mad or there was some secret behind it, because he was the director and marker of the path. It was beyond his ocean-like wisdom, that madness would make him talk foolish. God forbid! His grandeur is so perfect that clouds of some sickness would not hide this moon. He has got himself imprisoned because of the mischiefs of the common people; and having been disgusted by the shameful acts of the wise, he has gone mad to be away from them. He pretended to be mad to go to prison to avoid the disgrace of the dictates of the body which has dulled human wisdom; saying: O soldiers! catch hold of me and whip me on my head and back and do not hesitate to do so; so that I may get life with the beatings of the hunter made of leather just as a murdered person had got back his life; with the piece of the cow’s leather. I may get pleased, just as the murdered person had become happy with the cow connected with H.Musa(During the days of H.Musa, a young man murdered his uncle, but the murderer could not be found. H.Musa got a cow sacrificed and hit the dead man with a piece of cow’s leather. The murdered man got back to life and revealed the identity of his killer).

The dead man got back life with the whipping of the cow’s leather, just as copper becomes pure gold with the impact of alchemy. The murdered man revealed the identity of those who killed him, who had sowed the seeds of mischief.

sections.heading: Crushing of Body to Re- Awaken Soul:
paras: When the heavy human body dies, the soul, as the carrier of his secrets gets into a new life. His soul looks at hell and paradise, and comes to know of all the secrets. It exposes the murderous devils and the nets of treacheries and frauds. This can also be so during life time when the soul within the body is kept alive by crushing the body. Sacrificing the cow, meaning the body, is a precondition to know these secrets, so that the soul may receive whippings from the hunter of the cow's leather. Therefore, sacrifice the cow of your ego fast, so that the hidden soul may come out fast. Do not search for the beginning and end of this matter. Tell us as to what happened to the disciples of H.Zunnuun Misri.

When those people went to H.Zunnuun, he shouted at them as to who they were. With due respect they said: “We are among your friends with all our heart and soul. We have come to enquire about you. How are you, O ocean of strange wisdom? What is this allegation of madness against you. How can the smoke from the furnace reach upto the sun? How can Anqa, the largest bird, be defeated by the crow? Please do not hide from us and tell us as to what happened. We are friends: do not ignore us. Friends should not be chased away. It is not proper to hide your face and make pretexts with us. Keep the secrets before the friends. Please accept our request, as you are the ocean of wisdom and knowledge. O king! Please reveal to us the secret. O moon, do not hide your face behind the clouds. We are your real friends with broken hearts. Our hearts are connected with you in both the worlds. Please tell us as to what happened! Please do not keep us in suspense”.

sections.heading: Trial of Friendship:
paras: When H.Zunnuun heard this, he did not find a way to keep them away from him, other than through a trial. Deliberately he started abusing them with foul words. He started blabbering nonsense like mad men. He jumped up and started throwing stones and sticks upon them. Out of the fear of getting injured, they all ran away from him. He laughed loudly and shook his head and said: “ See, where are their false claims of friendship. Look at these friends. Where do they have the marks of friendship in them? Friends never care for their lives. A friend never goes away upon the troubles given by the friend. Friendship is only a rind, the reality of friendship is the pulp. Bear with the troubles if you are a friend. Do not turn away from him if you are a man of good conduct. Is not the friend's happiness a mark of friendship in bearing with hardships, troubles and calamities. Friends are like gold and troubles are like fire! Pain of the heart for a friend is like fire which makes friendship perfect.

Was it not a fact that H.Luqmaan was a good slave rendering smart service to the master day and night. His master would always keep him in front of him and loved him more than his children. Because, though H.Luqmaan was the child of a slave, he was a great master that he had freed himself from all desires and passions of the self.

sections.heading: Men as Slaves of Wrath and Passions:
paras: In earlier days, one of the kings asked a great man to seek some grant from him. The great man said: “O king, do you not feel ashamed that you say this to me. Be something greater than this! I have two slaves, who are worthless; but both of them are your leaders and masters”. The king asked him: “Who are those two? This is a disgrace to me to be their slave and be under them.”. The shaikh said:” They are wrath and passions”.

Consider him to be a king who has no concern even for his kingship. His brightness should dominate over the sun and moon. He possesses a hidden treasure (of wisdom and knowledge) before which the treasure of gold and gems is worthless. He has an existence, which is an enemy of existence. H.Luqmaan’s master, in spite of being a master and Luqmaan his slave, in reality was a slave and Luqmaan who was his master. In this perverse world, there are many situations where gems are less valuable than a scraps of grass. A desert is called a place of gain; and honour and disgrace become a trap for their wisdom.

sections.heading: Mistaken Notions of Hypocrites:
paras: One group of people considers dress as the means of recognition. One in simple clothings is considered a layman. Another group considers sweetness of tongue, oratory and hypocrisy as piety adopting designations of in-depth piety. Another group with apparent oratory and hypocrisy traps simpletons into the belief of piety, who do not possess the light of heart to differentiate between treachery and piety. A light without blind followership and independence of mind is required to understand man without seeing his acts, and hearing his speech; and to penetrate into his heart through the path of wisdom, and see his worth, and not to go with hearsay about him.

sections.heading: Hypocrites Become Known to the Learned:
paras: Special bondsmen of the Knower of the secrets (Allaamul ghuyuub: God) are the spies of the hearts for the world of spirits. Whatever thoughts that occur in the hearts of the people become bright and apparent before them. What all a sparrow has in its body cannot remain hidden from the wisdom of the falcon. The one who has become aware of the secrets of God, can never remain uninformed of the secrets of the others. What difficulty is there for one to walk on earth who has passed through the heavens. When iron becomes soft like wax in the hands of H.Dawood, imagine what will happen to wax.

H.Luqmaan to look at, was a slave and slavery was an apparent aspect of his life. When a master goes to an unknown place, he puts on the royal apparels on the slave; and himself wears the clothings of the slave. He makes the slave as his leader in front of him and follows him like slaves, so that nobody may recognize his reality. He tells the slave: “Sit upon the royal chair and I shall stand like a slave holding your footwear. Be harsh with me and speak to me in strict words and even abuse me, and do not ever show any respect to me. Your obedience to my commands is that you should not obey, but command me, as I have such a seed of design for my journey in the unknown place”.
Great man became lowly to deny publicity:

Many great men of spritualism have resorted to slavery and lowly professions, so that people may take them as slaves and lowly ones, and that they may remain hidden from them. They had no regard for lordship and never cared for status so that from low levels they may go closer to God. But there are slaves of desires and ambitions who are quite different from the great saints. They project themselves as leaders of wisdom and attainments of high spiritual levels. From the great souls, you learn the path of self-destruction and lowliness, as other than lowliness, nothing is suitable for a bondsman of God. Thus, there are many artificial things for projection relating to this and that world. Try to understand such artificial things in the opposite way. These worldly men resort to pomp and pageantry; and those of that world to lowliness and humbleness. The master of H.Luqmaan knew well of his secret that he was a great master but has voluntarily chosen slavery. He had seen many marks of this fact. In-spite of this he was managing his master-ship in order to meet the inner design of H.Luqmaan. He would have set free H.Luqmaan long back; but he was after H.Luqmaan’s appeasement, because that was his object that nobody should come to know of this young lion's secret. It is not strange that you hide your secret from a bad person, but hiding it from your own self is very strange and considering your achievements as no achievements at all. Attend to your jobs by hiding them from yourself, so that nobody may cast an evil eye upon your jobs. Carry on lowly professions in order to be a thief of your own good qualities, and this theft will make you all the more guilt-conscious.

sections.heading: Discard Petty Things to Protect Great Ones:
paras: Opium is given to an injured man in order to remove the arrow from his body. At the time of death one feels as though one’s body is being torne to pieces and one’s entire attention is cast upon the pains; and the soul stealthily goes out of the body. It happens that when your full attention is engaged in some affair, your materials are stealthily taken away by lifters. Therefore, when you remain engaged in thoughts, do so in respect of greater thoughts, so that what is lifted by thieves is an inferior thing. You will have the feeling that what you lost was lowly and what you got is great. The thief lifts only that about which you are careless and contented of sufficient protection. But when he sees that you are very careful about something he never thinks about stealing.

Know this: when a ship is about to sink and its weight is required to be reduced, merchants throw away materials of lesser value. In this manner the less worthy materials become the protectors of worthy materials. Because, something or the other has to be thrown out in water to protect the ship from sinking. Therefore, you may pick up cheap and lowly materials to be discarded to protect the worthy and valuable.Know this well to protect the wealth of faith, so that you may not have to feel sorry before God. When you keep your wealth under your care and protection, the mean devi will carry away your lowly possessions of greed and carelessness.

As the master of H.Luqman had found out his greatness, he became his slave and fell in love with him. He used to present any food that came to him so that he may put his hand in it first in order to eat his leftovers. This food used to make the master much pleased; and any food that he would not eat was destroyed. If he ate, it was without a sense of taste and pleasure. This is the extent of one’s unlimited connections.

sections.heading: H.Luqmaan Ate Bitter Melon with Pleasure:
paras: Once a watermelon was received by his master as a gift and at that time H.Luqmaan was not present. He sent another slave to call him. When H.Luqmaan came and sat before him, he took a knife in his hand and sliced it and gave a slice to him. H.Luqmaan ate it with great relish as though it was sugar and honey. After this, his master gave him another slice; and after that as many as seventeen slices. He ate with such relish that the onlookers also developed a desire to eat. The master ate the last slice saying he would know how tasty it was. But when he ate, he found it to be so bitter that it caused a fire in his mouth, boils came about on his tongue and his throat burnt. For some time he was in distress at this bitter taste and after getting a little peace said:”O soul of the world, how did you eat so much of poison? Why is this patience and of what kind is it? This is as though your soul is inimical to your life. Why did you not plead an excuse saying: “I have some difficulty. Please wait for sometime.”

H.Luqmaan said: “I have eaten so much from your generous hands all these days that I feel myself bent down before you in shame. I feel it shameful in not eating a bitter thing given by your hand, my master! You know this master! All the parts of my body have developed under you benevolence and are sunk under the gifts of your food and maintenance. If I make a hue and cry upon one bitter thing from you, it is so shameful on my part that black dust should fall upon my body. Your sweet-giving-hand has given such a taste that the bitterness of this melon has left”.

sections.heading: Impacts of Love:
paras: Love makes bitterness sweet and copper becomes gold in love. Residues become filtered liquids and pains become medicine. Love makes the thorns as flowers. And with love vinegar becomes wine. Love makes the scaffold a throne and burdens become fortune. With love, a prison becomes a garden and without love, a garden becomes a furnace. Love makes light from fire and a devil as a hoor. Stones become soft like oil and without love, wax becomes hard like iron. Sorrows become joys in love and a ghost becomes a guide. With love the stings of beetles become honey and a lion becomes a rat. It converts sickness into health and wrath into mercy. A thorn becomes a flower and a dark house becomes bright. The dead become alive and a king becomes a slave.

sections.heading: Love: a Product of Wisdom:
paras: Love is also a product of intelligence. One without sense cannot sit on this throne of love. Imperfect wisdom cannot create love. And if it does, it is on an imperfect thing. When the colour of the true beloved is seen on that imperfect thing, it drags him just as the mimicked sound of a bird drags the birds. Imperfect wisdom does not see the difference between real and unreal. It mistakes the flash of lightning as the light of the sun. It mistakes the mortal as immortal. That is why the Prophet has called a man lacking perfectness as accursed. Interpreters consider the lack of perfectness as of wisdom and not of the body; because an imperfect body is in need of mercy and support and not of abuse and condemnation. Deficiency of wisdom is a sickness which is a curse and requires the one with it to be kept away. It is not impossible to make wisdom perfect, as in the company of the wise, a less wise fellow can become wiser. But there is no scope for perfecting the imperfectness of the body.

Mischiefs of Pharaoh and of all unbelievers are all products of imperfect wisdom. Concessions are provided for persons of physical defects. The Quran says that there is no sin upon the blind: There is no fault in the blind; nor in one born lame: “Laisa ala al a’maa harajun, walaa ala a’raja harajun”: (Noor: 24: 61)

sections.heading: Flashes of Lightnings:
paras: Lightning vanishes fast and is unfaithful. One without the light of wisdom cannot differentiate between the temporary and lasting light. You will see that lightning makes fun of those who develop love for it. The feet of the lightning are cut off and they are like those that neither rise nor set. Lightning snatches away the sight of infidels: “yakaadul barqu yakh ta fu absaarahum”: (Baqarah: 2: 20). Consider its light as the one that snatches the light of your eyes and the other light as one that is permanent. One should not drive his horse on the froth of the sea, nor should he try to read a letter in the flashes of lightning. Greed keeps one away from the long range results.It is like making fun of one’s own wisdom and heart.

sections.heading: Trials upon Wisdom for Enhancement:
paras: Wisdom by its very nature looks at distant objectives; and the self of man full of desires, does not look at distant results. Wisdom that gets defeated by the vicious self becomes like the senseless self. When Venus gets trapped by Saturn, it causes disaster. In this situation also, you may turn your eyes to look at that Essence (God) that has caused disaster to you. When you fall into insinuations and doubts, you should not concentrate on them but concentrate towards God to know whether these are from God, and seek from Him an elevation of state as against a downfall through them. There are changes of elevation and downfall which upon proper observation, lead you to better merit. They are brought out for you to create opposites to bring about change in you, as upon getting rid of troubles you attain greater merit. So also that you may develop the fear of the records of those on the left side (zatasshimal) and desire for the record of those on the right side (zatalyamin). That is, fear of the wrongs and desire for good acts. Because, until you see the fears of the shortfalls, you cannot enjoy the pleasures of good achievements. Because, so long as you do not see fears of those in disastrous situations on the left side, you will not value the comforts of those on the right side. This is to make you a bird of two wings as a bird with only one wing is incapable of flying.

sections.heading: Right, Left and Forward Groups:
paras: Now, you may pass off from those of the right and left side and enter into the house of the foremost as stated in the Quran: “Was sabiqoon as sabiqoon; uulaa’ikal muqarrabun”: Those Foremost will be the Foremost; they will be the nearest to God: ( Al Waqi’a: 56: 10). They are in front of those on the right and left side. Either you should hear with full attention to me and permit me to speak, or you should go away so that I may not say anything. Whether you like this or like that, it is your choice. No one can know as to what you want. The soul of H.Ibrahim required to see the light in fire through which to see the paradise and palaces therein, and also to go step by step beyond the moon and sun and not be like a link held in the chain at the door. When one goes beyond the seventh heaven like H. Ibrahim, then only one will be in a position to say: I do not love those that set: “Laa uhibbul a’afileena”: (An’am 6: 76). This bodily material world is the one to put everyone on the wrong path except the one who has stayed away from meeting its desires.

Story of the king, his ministers and their envy with a chosen wiser slave has remained incomplete due to prolonged discussion with a very talkative person. We have to return to it and complete it. The similitude of the king and his slaves is like that of the gardener and the garden trees. He knows which trees are of bitter and unworthy fruits and which ones are equal to seven hundred trees in worth. He cannot keep them all upon the same consideration with his far-sightedness. He knows the ultimate ends of all the trees, even though all of them appear the same to look at.

Similarly, a great master who sees objects with the light of God sees the beginning and end of his disciples. He keeps those eyes closed which see only the worldly things like the eyes of the animals that look at fodder alone. He keeps his far-sighted eyes open in the beginning itself. These envious fellows were like the bad big trees of unfortunate bitter fruits. They were at the height of jealousy, full of disgust and cunning to make a treachery so as to kill the especially chosen slave and uproot him completely. But that fellow could not be killed as he was a beloved of the king and his roots were under the protection of God. The king came to know of their secret designs but kept quiet, just like Abu Bakr Rababi, who had not opened his mouth and said anything for seven years. The king silently clapped his hands upon their designs which were like the designs that a potter makes on his pots. Those people were making their designs to keep the king also in darkness about their designs.

sections.heading: Master Knows the Disciple’s Mind:
paras: They were making designs even against the great king foolishly, without knowing that such a king cannot remain ignorant of their designs. Their designs were those very designs that they had learnt from him. That disciple is unfortunate who desires to face his master and outbeat him. That too, against a master who was a master of spiritualism before whom every open and hidden thing is clear. His eyes are those that see things with the light of God which can tear the curtains of ignorance. They wanted to hide things covered by an old blanket from a heart which can see things through its numerous holes. The curtain put by them laughs at them with its hundred holes which have all become wide open like mouths.

The master tells him: “You are lesser than a dog in faithfulness. You are not faithful to me. You may not take me as so great a master who would smash iron, and consider me as a dark-hearted fellow like you. Do not forget at least, that my life and soul have been of great help to you. What all you have attained so far is because of me. My heart has been the workshop of your jobs. Why do you break this workshop in a foolish manner”.

sections.heading: Master’s Silence Is Not Due to Ignorance:
paras: Then you tell him: “I secretly rub upon the flint to keep the fire of regard for you alone”. But the master understands the treachery behind words as there is a way from heart to heart. His heart looks at you through its holes and his heart gives the evidence about you. But because of his nobility, he does not speak of it to you. He just smiles at whatever you say and says: “alright”. He smiles at you not for getting convinced at your statement but as a mark of the fact that he has not been fooled. The trick is answered with a trick. One verbal slap is answered with silent smile.

If the master’s smiles are out of love and appreciation for you, thousands of flowers would bloom for you. If his heart comes to you with concurrence, you may think that the sun has come into the constellation of Taurus, which causes smiles of the days and spring season. Meadows and buds come together happily. Thousands of bulbuls and other birds start chirping with joy and bring about the pleasures of the spring to the devastated part of the world. The blessings of the master fall upon you like the spring and bring about great spiritual pleasures. But when you do not know the difference between autumn and spring, what hints can you get from the phrase of “the ripening of fruits”.

sections.heading: But When the Leaves of Your Soul Have Gone Pale and Black, You Cannot Understand the Impacts of the Master’s Anger. When the Sun of the Master Out of Anger Enters into the Constellation of Mercury Which Is Also Called as the Writer of the Sky, It Will Blacken the Record of Your Actions. Our Soul Is Like a Paper for Mercury but We See Only the White Paper with Black Writings on It. the Impacts of the Master’s Anger Will Be in a Similar Manner. Later, He Writes the Command in Red and Green Ink and Consequent upon This, Our Souls Get Rid of Our Madness and Weaknesses. the Green and Red Writings Are Those of the Spring Season, Which in Our Imagination Are Like the Rainbow. These Are the Different Impacts of the Blessings of the Master
paras: In this connection, you may hear this narrative, so that you may also get a general pardon.

May a hundred times more benevolances be upon Bilqis to whom God gave the wisdom of a hundred men. The hoopoe brought a message and insignia with few words and explanations from H. Sulaiman. She read over those words, full of meanings and did not look at Hoopoe, the messenger, with contempt in spite of it being of no worth as a humble bird. Her eyes saw it as a hoopoe but her heart saw it as a Anqa (Anqa is a legendary bird with long neck and very large size, which could swallow large-sized animals and men. It had four legs, a face resembling human face and very large-sized feathers of various colors. Upon the curse of Prophet Hanza bin Safavan, it was annihilated or thrown and confined into some unknown island －lughaat-e-kishwari). Her eyes saw H. Sulaiman’s letter as froth on the seashore but her heart found it to be large like the sea.

sections.heading: Difference Between Wisdom and Senses:
paras: There is always a confrontation between the two colors of wisdom and senses. Senses sees only the apparent, material objects but wisdom sees things beyond matter into essences, abstracts and non-material matters, just as between the noble Prophet and Abu Jahl. Non-believers saw the Prophet only as a man but did not see the miracle of the splitting of the moon that occurred in Makka to show to them that he was not only a man but also a prophet. Therefore, do not give importance to what your physical eyes see, as they are enemies of wisdom and faith. The physical eye has been referred to as blind, an idol-worshipper and enemy. See ayat: “Qul hal yastawil al a’maa wa albasiir”: Can the blind be held equal to the seeings: (An’am: 6: 50). In this ayat the blind are referred to as those who see only with the physical eyes and are deprived of the seeing with the heart. Because they look at the froth and not at the sea; because they see only the presently existing things and not the things that are to come later.

sections.heading: Prophets Exceptional Men:
